Deloitte Innovation Hub | Planning Business Analyst, Cairo, Egypt
 Location
 Egypt Delivery Center
 Deloitte Innovation Hub |Planning Business Analyst, Cairo, Egypt
Connect to your career at Deloitte
Deloitte, established globally in 1845, is the world’s largest and leading professional services firm, providing Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal and Consulting and related services to public and private clients spanning multiple industries. Present in more than 150 countries, Deloitte is distinct in its ability to help clients solve their most complex problems, from strategy to implementation.
Deloitte innovation hub (DIH) is a strategic initiative to support our ambition to become the leading business transformation partner of choice for our clients and to expand and scale our delivery footprint across EMEA. With access to a scaled, diverse, highly skilled, motivated, and engaged workforce, DIH is delivering complex technical solutions for clients’ most complex business problems, across portfolios that include ‘Strategy & Transactions’, ‘Customer’, ‘Engineering, AI & Data, ‘Enterprise, Technology & Performance’ and ‘Cyber’. DIH is aiming to become the destination for top talents in Egypt for a long, exciting career. 
We invest in outstanding people of diverse talents and backgrounds and empower them to achieve more than they could elsewhere. Our work combines advice with action and integrity. We believe that when our clients and society are stronger, so are we. Our organization has grown in scale and diversity, providing services across the region, with our shared culture remaining the same. We aim to help clients realize their ambitions, make a positive difference in society, and maximize the success of our people. This drive fuels the commitment and humanity that run deep through our every action.
Connect to your opportunity. 
Ready to launch your career at the intersection of supply chain planning, business analysis, and advanced technology? Deloitte is seeking a Junior or Experienced Graduate to join our Supply Chain Planning practice in Cairo. This is an exciting opportunity for ambitious graduates to contribute to end-to-end OMP implementation projects for leading clients across the globe. You will help translate planning challenges into scalable digital solutions across demand planning, supply planning, production planning, inventory optimisation, and sales and operations planning, delivering tangible impact from day one.
You will collaborate with experienced supply chain planners, business analysts, solution architects, and technical specialists. Your responsibilities will include analysing current planning processes and data, documenting business requirements, supporting solution design and configuration, preparing and executing functional tests, assisting with data validation and integration, and supporting training, deployment, and adoption. You will work directly with client stakeholders to connect business needs with OMP capabilities and help deliver robust, user-focused planning solutions.
Connect to your skills and professional experience
You need:
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in supply chain management, industrial engineering, operations research, computer science, information systems, applied mathematics, or a related discipline, with graduation in 2024 or 2025.
* 0–2 years of professional experience in supply chain planning, business analysis, advanced planning systems, software implementation, data analytics, or consulting.
* Understanding of core supply chain planning concepts such as demand forecasting, supply and capacity planning, production planning and scheduling, inventory optimisation, master data, and sales and operations planning.
* Ability to elicit, analyse, document, and validate business requirements and translate them into functional specifications, process flows, user stories, and test scenarios.
* A strong academic record and excellent analytical, numerical, and structured problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate clearly with business and technical stakeholders.
* Attention to detail and the ability to work with complex datasets, identify data-quality issues, and support reconciliation and validation activities.
* A proactive, collaborative, and client-focused attitude, with the ability to learn quickly and work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
Preferred Skills:
* Exposure to OMP Unison Planning or another Advanced Planning and Scheduling (APS) platform, such as Kinaxis, SAP Integrated Business Planning, Blue Yonder, or similar enterprise planning solutions.
* Academic or practical experience with supply chain planning models, optimisation, forecasting, scenario analysis, or production scheduling.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying, validating, transforming, and troubleshooting planning data.
* Exposure to C++ development, object-oriented programming, algorithms, or debugging; experience with Python or another scripting language is an additional advantage.
* Experience supporting enterprise-system implementation activities, including configuration, data migration, interfaces, functional and integration testing, defect resolution, deployment, and hyper care.
* Knowledge of ERP and integration concepts, databases, APIs, cloud environments, software development lifecycles, and IT service-management practices.
* Relevant supply chain or planning certification, such as ASCM CPIM, CSCP, or CLTD, or recognized training in OMP or another APS platform.
Required Software Skills:
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, OneNote, OneDrive, and Teams.
* Ability to use Excel for data analysis and reconciliation; familiarity with SQL development tools, relational databases, version control, and issue-tracking or testing tools is appreciated.
* Exposure to OMP, another APS application, ERP systems, data-integration tools, or programming environments for C++ or Python is considered a strong advantage.
Connect to your business – Technology & Transformation
Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters.
Personal Independence
Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to several audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints. This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm. The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process.
Connect with your colleagues
Location: Cairo, Egypt
“What attracted me to Deloitte were the endless opportunities and the collective experience of other like-minded individuals. Deloitte’s clients include many of the world’s largest organizations; I wanted to be part of a team that made a difference that I could be proud of.” -Dan, Technology & Transformation
“Everyone always says “it’s the people,” and that’s true. Working for a brand you feel proud of feels pretty good too. And you don’t have any stress about fitting into a particular stereotype, because there are so many different types of people in Deloitte Digital.” – Gillian, Technology & Transformation
Our commitment to you
Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So, we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.
We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective, and personality. So, we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.
Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.
Connect to your next step
A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.

Consultant l Deal Transformation & Post Merger Integration l M&A - Commercial Advisory l Egypt
When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.
Our Purpose
Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges, and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations, and supporting our communities.
 Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:
* Lead the way.
* Serve with integrity.
* Take care of each other
* Foster inclusion
* Collaborate for measurable impact.
Our advisory team provides strategic and financial advisory services to clients throughout all phases of the deal cycle. Financial Advisory in Deloitte comprises several distinct but related global service lines whose shared principal objective is the creation and enhancement of shareholder value. The Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration team supports our clients in solving commercial questions with strategic importance to their business and are particularly focused on matters spanning the entire M&A lifecycle from growth strategy to target screening and due diligence, through integration and separation execution, and beyond.
We are looking for a high-performing person with expertise in Commercial Advisory services. As a Consultant, you will be responsible for working on engagements in M&A strategy, market feasibility study, commercial due diligence, strategy development, business plan review, competition assessment, etc.
Working with professionals in our M&A – Deals team, you will have an opportunity to:
* Prepare, manage, and deliver assignments: typically have day-to-day responsibility for managing small assignments or major modules of larger assignments. This includes liaison with clients and other stakeholders, understanding client issues, defining problem statement, developing hypotheses, structuring the approach and analysis, developing projections & business plans and directing key individuals within the team.
* Develop an approach and conduct the detailed research and analysis to address areas of scope in the engagement, utilising appropriate tools and techniques
* Get involved in business development and marketing activities to initiate and maintain contact with target companies, private equity and other clients.
Leadership Capabilities
* Build own understanding of our purpose and values; explore opportunities for impact.　
* Demonstrate strong commitment to personal learning and development; act as a brand ambassador to help attract top talent.　
* Understand expectations and demonstrate personal accountability for keeping performance on track.　
* Actively focus on developing effective communication and relationship-building skills.

Job description
Connect to your Industry
Do you want to contribute to some of the UK’s most significant and ambitious digital programmes, helping our clients deliver outcomes that support national security?
We are proud of the impact we have with our Defence & Security clients, the strength of our relationships, and the variety of our skills and expertise that we bring to help them achieve their mission.
We’re growing our teams across all of Technology and Transformation. If you are cleared to SC or DV level and want to grow your career in this sector, we are very keen to hear from you.
Connect to your career at Deloitte
Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.
Connect to your opportunity
Are you passionate about building your career in complex, technology-enabled transformation programmes?
Our clients operate in an environment shaped by increasing complexity, rapid technological change and evolving social and economic challenges. They need multidisciplinary teams that combine clear thinking, effective delivery governance and human-centred, technology-enabled change to deliver outcomes with confidence.
Within Deloitte’s Human Capital practice, you will work as part of multidisciplinary teams supporting some of the most important and demanding programmes in Defence, Security and Justice. These programmes often sit at the intersection of operating model change, workforce transformation, digital capability, and large-scale technical delivery and adoption.
You will support the design and delivery of complex engagements, taking responsibility for defined tasks and deliverables with guidance from more experienced colleagues. You will work closely with clients and multidisciplinary teams, build your understanding of delivery challenges and contribute practical ideas and high-quality outputs. As your capability develops, you may take ownership of broader deliverables or coordinate specific activities. You will build your skills in programme delivery, client engagement and technology-enabled transformation using Deloitte’s methods, tools and global capabilities.
Major Programmes Communities
Within Major Programmes, you’ll focus on working with clients across the South and South West of England.
Your role will allow you to:
* Work alongside engineering and digital delivery teams, developing experience in areas such as product management, Scrum Master, DevOps or related delivery approaches.
* Support effective project, programme or portfolio governance by producing accurate delivery artefacts, including plans, change information and workshop outputs.
* Contribute to digital transformation engagements through activities such as operating model design and implementation, business analysis and scaled agile delivery.
* Support PMO and programme controls activities, including progress reporting, financial tracking, planning, RAID management, and data analysis and visualisation.
* Contribute to the mobilisation and delivery of large-scale technology-enabled transformations, including programme setup, governance and delivery planning.
* Gather and analyse information on programme performance across scope, budget, risk, dependencies and outcomes, highlighting issues and supporting clear reporting.
* Take responsibility for defined tasks and deliverables, working with business, technical and delivery colleagues to complete them to a high standard.
* Build confidence working with clients, contribute effectively to meetings and support proposals and other business-development activities.
* Share practical insight, reusable materials and lessons learned to support our propositions, delivery methods and industry perspectives.
Connect to your skills and professional experience
All applicants must hold UK security clearance for a minimum of SC level.
Essential:
* Some practical experience of contributing to technology-enabled projects, programmes or transformation initiatives, gained in a professional, academic or comparable setting.
* An interest in the Defence or Security environment and the ability to develop relevant sector knowledge quickly.
* Ability to take responsibility for defined tasks and deliverables, seek guidance when needed and produce accurate, high-quality outputs.
* Awareness of, or experience applying, at least one relevant delivery capability, such as project or programme management, PMO, business analysis, agile delivery, product management or engineering delivery.
* Ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, clients and stakeholders, adapting your style to the audience and contributing confidently to discussions.
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify relevant information, recognise delivery risks or issues and present clear findings.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, respond positively to feedback and contribute to shared outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to organise your own work, manage priorities and adapt when requirements or delivery conditions change.
* An interest in developing commercial awareness, including an understanding of delivery constraints, financial considerations, suppliers and how proposals support client relationships.
Connect to your business - Technology and Transformation
Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, innovation and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest tech and transformational challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters.
Human Capital
People are what powers enterprise. That’s why we need to focus on the human experience in an ever-changing, digital world. We help clients utilise technology to support their workforce, organisation, and HR Transformations.
Personal independence
Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints (e.g., in relation to any financial interests and employment relationships). This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm, and also prohibitions on certain employment relationships (e.g., you are not permitted to hold a secondary employment role with SEC audit clients of the firm whilst being employed by the firm). The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process or you can contact the Independence team upon request.
Connect with your colleagues
“The great culture, flexibility, and range of experiences that Deloitte offers are what sets this firm apart. In Human Capital, Deloitte is far ahead of any of our immediate competitors.” - Sophia, Technology & Transformation.
Our hybrid working policy
You’ll be based in Bristol with hybrid working.
At Deloitte we understand the importance of balancing your career alongside your home life. That’s why we’ll support you to work flexibly through our hybrid working policy. Depending on the requirements of your role, you’ll have the opportunity to work in your local office, virtual collaboration spaces, client sites and remotely. You’ll get the chance to meet face to face when needed, while you collaborate and learn from colleagues, share your experiences, and build the relationships that will fuel your career and prioritise your wellbeing. Please check with your recruiter for the specific working requirements that may apply for your role.
Our commitment to you
Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.
We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective and personality. So we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.
Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.
Connect to your next step
A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.
Discover more reasons to connect with us, our people and purpose-driven culture at deloitte.co.uk/careers

Deloitte’s Financial Services industry group strives to support clients in addressing the strategic, operational, regulatory, and technological challenges shaping today’s industry. Deloitte’s global network of member firms engages clients to refine their business models through innovative practices, improved processes, and enabling information technologies.

In this role, you will own and contribute to defined workstreams across a range of Wealth and Private Banking engagements, with a focus on client experience, operating model redesign, digital enablement, process improvement, and automation. * Contributing to the design of omnichannel client journeys across onboarding, client portals, Relationship Manager tools, mobile and web channels, and assisted-service environments.

* You will support Deloitte’s and our clients’ business growth by:
* Owning assigned workstreams and coordinating activities, deliverables, dependencies, and timelines with Deloitte and client stakeholders.

Senior Analyst – Power & Utilities, Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I),R&I-Hyderabad/Mumbai
 If you are passionate about providing quality insights obtained through research and would like to leverage your strengths to support Deloitte’s thoughtware, this could be the role for you. The role provides an opportunity to get involved in activities that help develop and deliver Deloitte’s thought leadership and client briefings in the power and utilities sector (P&U) and renewable energy (RE) industry. A self-motivated individual who is accustomed to working well in a close-knit team would be a good fit. As part of this team, you’ll gain exposure to a variety of resources and collaboration opportunities that will help in developing your skills and professional development.
 Please explore deloitte.com and deloitte.com/insights to explore our papers and capabilities.
 Work you'll do
 As a Senior Analyst – Power & Utilities on the Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I) Research & Insights (R&I) team, you will be responsible for…
 * Developing research proposals and hypotheses for thought leadership and client briefings focused on the power and utilities and renewable energy industries.
 * Conducting secondary research, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data, and synthesizing findings into industry perspectives.
 * Applying research methodologies, including surveys, financial analysis, and case studies, to support business decision-making.
 * Preparing research briefings, written materials, and presentation content for clients and Deloitte leaders.
 * Collaborating with project leads and senior team members in the United States and India to deliver research projects.
 The team
 The PU&R sector is part of the broader Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I) industry team within the R&I group. The ER&I industry team comprises individuals with varied subject matter expertise and skill sets that enables members to work both independently and collaboratively on small and large projects.
 The overall R&I group’s objective is to develop compelling and forward-looking perspectives that allow clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The perspectives are formed by regular scanning and analysis of shaping trends, industry and company level developments, and regulatory environment. The group plays an integral role in strengthening the firm's strategic positioning in the marketplace and through end-to-end development of high-quality thoughtware.
 Location: Mumbai, Hyderabad
 Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM
 Qualifications
 Required:
 * Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management (PGDBM).
 * 3-4 years of experience conducting research, analysis, and writing in United States power and utilities or renewable energy markets.
 * Experience developing research proposals and hypotheses and conducting secondary research.
 * Experience analyzing quantitative and qualitative data and producing written research reports, client briefings, or presentation materials.
 * Experience applying at least one research methodology: surveys, financial analysis, case studies, forecasting or simulation, text analysis, regulatory review, mergers and acquisitions analysis, or social-media research.
 * Experience using one or more online research databases, including Bloomberg, Hoovers, Factiva, OneSource, Thomson, or AlphaSense.
 * Experience preparing business presentations for clients or senior leaders.
 Preferred:
 * Experience tracking and summarizing government filings and company strategy in the United States power and utilities or renewable energy industries.
 * Experience using Tableau or Microsoft Power BI to develop data visualizations.
 * Experience using generative artificial intelligence tools for research or productivity workflows and validating source information before including it in research outputs.
 * Experience working with virtual teams in India and the United States.

jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
About the team 
Our team of 30 colleagues has been the driving force for innovation in the area of document automation within the PwC Network. The team operates a document automation platform that is being used in almost 50 countries, will soon provide the services to the whole PwC Network globally and expand to external markets. Besides that, our team provides to our clients a broad range of document-related services, such as contract management, invoice automation, regulated documents, or records management. A career in our team will provide you with a significant variability of activities, tasks and projects and will enable you to participate on global projects. 
About your manager 
Štěpán is a Senior Manager at PwC with over 25 years of experience in business consulting, IT management, and document automation. 
Štěpán is a coaching‑oriented leader who helps team members grow into autonomous professionals, supporting them with deep know‑how and experience. Over his career, he has contributed to some of the largest DMS deals in the Czech Republic, implemented systems automating more than one million invoices annually. His passion is helping organizations escape document chaos, strengthen compliance, and benefit from efficient, modern workflows — while exploring how AI and large language models can further transform document processing. At PwC, Štěpán’s mission is to build a strong senior team capable of delivering impactful solutions on international projects and using cutting‑edge technologies. 
In his free time, he teaches diving, combining discipline, calm leadership, and a passion for helping others grow — both underwater and in professional life. 
Job description & summary
We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our Document Automation team in Prague. With 30 specialists supporting a platform used across nearly 50 countries — and soon across the entire PwC network — you will help deliver a broad portfolio of document‑related services, from contract management and invoice automation to regulated documents, records management, and large‑scale workflow automation. 
As a Business Consultant, you will work across all project stages and help clients transform the way they manage documents and processes. You will engage directly with clients, understand their challenges, and translate them into solutions built on leading DMS, ECM, AI, workflow and process‑automation technologies. The role offers the opportunity to work on impactful local and international projects, collaborate with experienced colleagues, and further develop your consulting, technical, and project skills — including exposure to modern AI‑driven automation. 
This role is ideal for a mid‑level consultant who wants to grow fast, work with world‑class technologies, and shape how organizations manage documents in an era where AI introduces new, exciting possibilities. 
You will: 
* Participate in early‑stage client discussions to identify document‑related pains and map them to suitable document‑automation solutions. 
* Present DMS capabilities and explain how specific platforms address client needs. 
* Conduct detailed requirements analysis and prepare structured business solution designs. 
* Facilitate client workshops, internal design sessions, and presentations throughout the project lifecycle. 
* Contribute to engagements, helping clients decide what solutions to implement, how best to implement them while ensuring delivery aligns with their expectations and agreed scope.
* Collaborate with other PwC teams — including Data and AI — to create holistic, value‑adding solutions for clients. 
* Engage in international projects and broaden your expertise in emerging automation approaches. 
* We help clients build modern, efficient and compliant document ecosystems — and you can be part of it. 
What matters to us
* 3–5 years of experience in IT consulting, business analysis, or a similar client‑facing role, with exposure to digital transformation, experience with document‑related solutions is an advantage. 
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to translate client needs into clear, structured technical requirements. 
* Confident communication and presentation abilities, including running client workshops and participating in presales discussions. 
* Curiosity about new trends in document automation, workflow technologies, and AI‑driven solutions. 
* Structured thinking, independence, teamwork, and the ability to communicate effectively with both clients and technical specialists. 
* University degree in a relevant field. 
* Proficiency in Czech and English, both spoken and written. 
* Willingness to work primarily from the Prague office when not on client engagements. 
What will help you stand out
* Understanding of how information systems work, including the ability to discuss processes with technical teams; hands‑on configuration experience.
* Experience with DMS/ECM tools, workflow automation, invoice automation, contract management, or AI‑based document processing.
Why you’ll enjoy working here
* Professional growth that matches your ambitions and pace. Gain in months the kind of experience that can take years to build elsewhere. 
* Fair pay with no gaps. We are among the few companies in the Czech Republic certified for Equal Pay. 
* A flexible benefits programme with 55,000 points to spend on what matters most to you. 
* 35 days of paid time off, including three well-being days and two additional days off at the end of the year. 
* An opportunity to give back to the community with one paid volunteering day every year. 
* The chance to work from one of PwC’s international offices (available from the Senior Associate level). 
* We support your learning and development journey: We offer training in business skills (such as presentation and communication skills, assertiveness, and giving feedback) as well as digital skills (including Alteryx, Power BI, and AI). Our technical training will help you understand the full deals transaction lifecycle and how to present our findings to clients in a clear and impactful way. We also cover the cost of professional certifications, such as CFA. 
* A buddy programme, regular feedback, and access to a coach who can support your professional development and career path. 
* Extensive well-being support and initiatives promoting a healthy lifestyle, from Dr. Digital and Human Dynamic programmes to workplace yoga and running events. 
* An ultrabook and an iPhone with unlimited data. 
* Social events and Away Days. 
Check us out on: Document Automation | Czech Republic
At PwC, we help clients solve today’s and tomorrow’s challenges across audit, consulting, tax, legal, technology, and data. We create an environment where people can learn, grow, and build a career in their own way. We believe the best results come from diverse experiences and perspectives. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves, build on their strengths, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.

* You are fluent in English and Dutch and/or French 
What you can expect from us 
At PwC, we invest in your growth, wellbeing and long-term career development: 
* Flexible working model with hybrid arrangements and adaptable schedules supporting your work-life balance 
* Continuous learning and career growth, with access to high-quality training, coaching and international opportunities 
* A flexible rewards package tailored to your personal needs, including mobility and lifestyle options 
* A diverse and inclusive workplace where you can be yourself and thrive 
* A strong focus on wellbeing, including health programmes, sports initiatives and mental resilience support 
* Opportunities to work on impactful, high-profile projects with leading clients 
* Access to a global network of experts and knowledge, enabling you to broaden your perspective and expertise 
Let’s build something meaningful together 
At PwC, your work has purpose. You’ll collaborate with diverse teams, solve important problems and help organisations navigate their most critical moments. 
We are committed to equal opportunities and inclusive hiring practices, in line with Belgian labour standards and GDPR regulations. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and bring their authentic selves to our team.

Kia ora, 
Be a catalyst for transformation. Shape the future at PwC New Zealand. 
At PwC, our purpose is clear: to build trust in society and solve important problems.

Ngā kōrero mo tēnei tūranga / About the role 
Join our Finance, Economics and Analytics team within Consulting, where we use data, analysis and commercial insight to help clients understand complex problems and make better decisions. 
Our work helps clients solve complex challenges as a team. This can include analysing organisational and service performance, identifying the drivers of financial and operational outcomes, developing financial models and business cases, assessing strategic options, undertaking economic and commercial analysis, and translating complex information into practical recommendations. 
Based in Pōneke / Wellington, you’ll be an integral part of our Consulting line of service, working with clients to turn data and evidence into clear insights and actions. 
Your day-to-day could include: 
* Delivering analytical and consulting projects across different industries, combining quantitative analysis, research, operational insights and commercial thinking to solve complex client problems. 
* Working with large or complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, variation and performance drivers, and developing hypotheses to explain what is happening and why. 
* Bringing together financial, operational and other data to build a richer understanding of organisational, service or portfolio performance. 
* Undertaking financial modelling, forecasting, cost-benefit analysis, performance analysis, economic analysis and other quantitative assessments to support strategic and operational decision-making. 
* Synthesising data, research and stakeholder perspectives into clear insights, identifying potential levers for improvement and translating analysis into practical recommendations. 
* Developing clear and compelling analysis, visualisations and presentations that make complex findings accessible to senior decision-makers. 
* Coaching, developing and supervising junior team members, supporting a culture of learning and growth. 
* Building trusted relationships with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

* A minimum of 4 years’ experience in the corporate, government, regulated or consulting sectors, with a experience using quantitative analysis and evidence to solve complex business or organisational problems. 
* Strong analytical capability, including the ability to structure ambiguous problems, interrogate data, identify patterns and drivers, test hypotheses and draw meaningful conclusions. 
* Experience working on complex analytical, performance, strategy, financial, economic or commercial projects. 
* Strong Excel skills and confidence working with complex datasets. Experience with data visualisation or analytical tools such as Power BI, SQL, Python or similar would be advantageous. 
* A degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline such as economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, data analytics, engineering or another relevant field is preferred; postgraduate qualifications would be advantageous. 
* Intellectual curiosity and a strong instinct for asking the questions behind the numbers - not just what is happening, but why it is happening and what can be done about it. 
* Advanced problem-solving skills, with well-developed business acumen and strategic insight. 
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex ideas clearly.

Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our people in deals focus on providing strategic advice and support to clients in areas such as mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring. They help clients navigate complex transactions and maximise value in their business deals.
Those in deal integration and valuation realisation at PwC will focus on assisting clients in successfully integrating acquisitions and maximising the value of their investments. The Opportunity 
 As a Deal and Value Creation Analytics member, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: 
* Supporting high profile analytics projects showcasing the drivers and equity story of a business either to management or to bidders to increase deal confidence 
* Supporting analytics projects to arm management with data driven insights to enable fact-based decision making and drive value within the business 
* Bringing structure and clarity to complex problems and business scenarios within tight deadlines 
* Using your technical know-how and translating this for our non-technical stakeholders to support robust, evidence-based decisions 
* Reviewing & creating reports and presentations and translating our findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders  
* Working with our Global Data Analytics community to further enhance our analytics proposition 
* Building and developing strong relationships at all levels both internally and externally

Management Level

Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our purpose is clear: to build trust in society and solve important problems. 
This is a place to keep growing. You’ll learn from the best, take on meaningful challenges, and make a lasting impact for our clients, our communities, and Aotearoa. 
Ngā kōrero mo tēnei tūranga / About the role 
At PwC’s Transformation Design & Delivery (TDD) practice, we work alongside clients to design and deliver complex transformation programmes across strategy, process, technology, and change. 
We are looking for an experienced Senior Analyst who is eager to build their transformation capability and play a meaningful role in delivering real outcomes for our clients within our Transformation Design & Delivery team in Tāmaki Makaurau / Auckland.
Make a substantial impact in the following areas: 
* Structure complex problems into clear, actionable plans and deliver high-quality outcomes that create real client impact.
* Work closely with clients to understand challenges, develop practical solutions, and build strong relationships that maintain alignment throughout delivery.
* Take ownership of defined deliverables and activities across transformation workstreams, from planning through to execution and implementation.
* Contribute to project management activities including planning, tracking, reporting and coordination, managing competing priorities and adapting to changing delivery needs.
* Proactively identify and manage risks, issues and dependencies, working with project leads to resolve or escalate these appropriately.
* Collaborate effectively across client, vendor and cross-functional teams to coordinate delivery and support successful implementation and service transition.
* Support junior team members and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing team culture, while helping strengthen our transformation tools, frameworks and ways of working.
* Leverage PwC’s coaching and development network to accelerate your growth and gain exposure to a broad range of transformation work.
Ngā pūkenga ka kawea mai e koe, ka whakawhanakehia rānei i tēnei tūranga  / Skills you will bring or develop in this role 
* 2 years’ experience in transformation, change, business analysis or PMO within consulting or professional services, including ownership and delivery of defined activities or deliverables. 
* A relevant tertiary qualification in business management, information systems, technology or a related discipline. 
* Experience supporting large-scale ERP and cloud transformation programmes, working collaboratively across business, technology and delivery teams to coordinate activities and support delivery in complex project environments.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across clients, project teams, business and technical stakeholders.
* Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to translate business requirements and technical information into practical actions and high-quality deliverables.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience bringing structure to ambiguity through approaches such as business analysis, process analysis, gap analysis and process mapping/design.
* Well-organised and proactive in approach, with the ability to manage milestones, risks, dependencies and competing priorities, take ownership of your work and deliver to deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* A collaborative mindset and willingness to learn, contribute to the development of others, and continue building your transformation delivery capability.
This is a full-time, permanent role with a minimum of 37.5 hours per week - Monday to Friday.

* Rewards - Discretionary bonus opportunities; generous referral bonuses; retail discounts & deals 
* Growth - Global network; leadership development; A.I. tools and training; formal learning pathways 
* Wellbeing - $250 annual wellbeing allowance; Life & income protection; Sonder/EAP/Headspace; 15 days’ paid sick leave; group-rate health insurance (eligibility applies) 
* Reputation - PwC is known for shaping tomorrow. Join us and you’ll accelerate your career while helping clients and communities solve their most important problems. 
* Flexibility - Flexible working; supportive coaching culture 
* Time off - Two paid recognition days off provided each year during our annual summer shutdown period; purchase up to two extra weeks’ annual leave 
* Whānau & community - Paid parental leave for all parents with flexible options and financial planning support; inclusive networks; paid volunteering leave

Management Level
Senior Associate
Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our people in workforce consulting focus on providing consulting services related to human resources, talent management, and organisational development. They analyse client needs, develop people and organisation strategies. These individuals offer guidance and support to help clients optimise their workforce, enhance employee engagement, and drive organisational effectiveness.
In HR transformation and technology at PwC, you will focus on providing consulting services related to the overall effectiveness and efficiency of the HR function and related technologies within organisations. You will work closely with clients to assess HR processes, policies, and systems, and provide guidance on HR transformation, technology implementation, and service delivery models. Your work will involve assisting clients in optimising their HR function to align with business objectives and enhance HR service quality.
Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical expertise and awareness of your strengths. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow.
Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
* Respond effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
* Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.
* Use critical thinking to break down complex concepts.
* Understand the broader objectives of your project or role and how your work fits into the overall strategy.
* Develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing.
* Use reflection to develop self awareness, enhance strengths and address development areas.
* Interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.
* Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.
Role Purpose 
The Workforce Transformation Senior Associate supports HR and workforce transformation engagements for clients, working within multidisciplinary teams and a blended delivery model. The role contributes to initiatives across the HR function and the broader workforce – including HRIS implementation, HR process optimisation, organisational change and adoption, strategic workforce planning support, reward, culture change, learning and development, and operating model and organisation design activities. 
Workforce Transformation in this context includes HR function optimisation as well as wider workforce strategy, analytics and operating model changes across employees, contingent workers and digitally enabled (AI/automation) ways of working. 
The Senior Associate focuses on analysis, documentation, and preparation of high‑quality deliverables, helping to embed digital and AI‑enabled ways of working into HR and workforce processes, and providing robust insight and support to managers and senior stakeholders. 
Key Responsibilities 
* Supporting teams in delivering programmes across the following Workforce capability areas: Organisational change and adoption, HR process/technology implementation, strategic workforce planning, operating model and organisation design, reward and recognition, culture, and learning and development. 
* Supporting the delivery of end-to-end projects against agreed timelines and quality standards, from design through to implementation, working closely with client stakeholders and other PwC team members.  
* Assisting in scoping, planning and delivery of client deliverables, working alongside other workstreams such as technology, process, and system design. 
* Supporting client interviews, workshops, and analysis of client documents and data to help develop a clear understanding of current state and future development. 
* Supporting business development activities to help identify and research opportunities on new/existing clients 
* Contributing to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages wellbeing, innovation and knowledge sharing. 
* Using and configuring digital tools where appropriate to support programme delivery and improve efficiency. 
* Using AI tools to enhance the delivery and quality of client engagements. 
* Supporting basic project management activities on Workforce engagements including the development and monitoring of project plans, RAID logs, status updates etc. 
Required Experience, Qualifications and Skills 
Experience 
* Typically 5+ years of experience in consulting or complex corporate environments, with involvement in HR and workforce transformation projects. 
* Proven track record of delivering end‑to‑end projects across Workforce capability areas (e.g. Organisational change and adoption, HR process/technology implementation, strategic workforce planning, operating model and organisation design, reward and recognition, culture, and learning and development.). 
* Experience working in multi‑disciplinary teams and, ideally, global or multi‑country programmes. 
Education and qualifications 
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Organisational Development or a related discipline. 
* Advantageous: Postgraduate qualification; project management / Agile training 
Skills 
* Good understanding of change management concepts and HR processes across the HR value chain. 
* Basic workforce analytics and use of data to support decision‑making. 
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, basic Power BI, collaboration tools and survey tools. 
* Comfort using AI‑enabled productivity tools.

Job Description & Summary
Senior AI Consultant, AI Trust & Governance
Make an impact with us
At PwC, you will help organisations build trust and deliver meaningful outcomes in a changing world. You will work in an inclusive and collaborative environment where diverse perspectives, continuous learning and responsible innovation are valued.
About the team
Our AI Trust team, within Assurance, helps organisations adopt and scale artificial intelligence responsibly, practically and sustainably.
We translate regulatory requirements, risk principles and responsible AI concepts into workable governance models, lifecycle processes and controls. Our goal is not governance for its own sake. We help clients use AI with confidence while managing risk throughout the AI lifecycle.
What your day will look like
You will work with multidisciplinary client teams across business, risk, technology, data, legal and compliance. Your responsibilities will include: 
* Designing practical AI governance structures, operating models, policies, processes and decision rights.
* Identifying AI systems and use cases, assessing their risks and defining proportionate governance requirements.
* Translating the EU AI Act and other relevant AI regulations into concrete actions, controls and documentation.
* Assessing existing AI controls, identifying gaps and embedding controls throughout the AI lifecycle.
* Conducting responsible AI and use case assessments covering transparency, human oversight, robustness, data governance, accountability, bias and explainability.
* Supporting the responsible rollout of Copilot and other Generative AI solutions.
* Helping clients turn complex AI risk and regulatory topics into clear guidance for business and technology teams.
* Contributing to client conversations, thought leadership and the continued development of our AI Trust services.
* Depending on your experience, you may also contribute to model validation, testing, monitoring, red teaming and AI assurance
What we will expect from you
* At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in consulting, AI governance, risk, technology, data, internal controls or digital transformation.
* A Master's degree in Business Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.
* Practical knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI principles, the EU AI Act and other relevant AI legislation.
* Experience designing or assessing governance frameworks, risk management processes, controls or operating models.
* Experience with AI, data, technology or digital risk, together with enough technical understanding to work confidently with technical teams.
* The ability to take ownership of a defined workstream, structure ambiguous problems and turn analysis into clear recommendations and client ready deliverables.
* A communicative, collaborative and results oriented approach, with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.
* The ability to build trusted relationships, involve diverse perspectives and adapt your communication to different audiences.
* A learning mindset and a willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues and contribute to an inclusive team environment.
* You are fluent in Dutch and/or French, with full professional proficiency in English.
Experience with Generative AI, foundation model risk, AI lifecycle controls, governance risk and compliance tooling, regulated industries or complex organisations is an advantage. 
Relevant certifications, including AIGP, GARP Risk and AI or ISO IEC 42001 Lead Implementer, are also valued.
What you can expect from us
* Challenging and meaningful work at the intersection of AI, regulation, risk and technology.
* Ownership of high impact client work, supported by collaborative and multidisciplinary teams.
* Continuous learning, mentorship and opportunities to deepen your AI Trust expertise.
* Exposure to different clients, sectors and strategic technology solutions.
* A flexible and inclusive environment where people are respected and encouraged to grow.
* Opportunities to build trusted client relationships and help shape our evolving AI Trust services.
Ready to make a difference
This is not primarily a legal interpretation or AI development role. It connects AI technology, regulation, governance risk and organisational realities.
If you want to help organisations use AI confidently and responsibly, while developing your expertise in a supportive, ambitious and fast paced environment, we would like to hear from you.

jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Chaque jour, nous exerçons des métiers d’excellence pour concrétiser notre ambition : être utiles à nos clients et accélérateurs de mouvement. 
Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences. 
Ce que nous recherchons ? Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble. 
Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.
Notre équipe 
Au sein de la practice Finance, notre équipe Consulting accompagne la transformation des Directions Financières de grands groupes français et internationaux, mais aussi les acteurs de la French Tech et du Next40. Nos projets embarquent toutes les dimensions technologiques et digitales. 
Dans le cadre du développement des équipes « Finance » à Paris, nous recherchons un(e) consultant(e) pour participer à des projets de transformation de Directions Financières de grandes Institutions Financières (Banque, Assurance, Gestion d’actifs). 
Vos missions 
Si vous vous reconnaissez dans l’une des affirmations ci-dessous, votre profil nous intéresse !  
- Vous avez envie de vous confronter aux enjeux business de réduction de coûts, de publication sur le marché, de pilotage de la performance 
- Vous êtes auditeur financier et souhaitez accompagner différemment vos clients via une expérience en consulting 
- Vous souhaitez accompagner les directions financières de grands groupes bancaires et assuranciels sur ces thématiques et disposez d’une expertise sur un ou plusieurs de ces sujets : 
* FP&A (Banque / Assurance) 
* TOM-FI (Banque / Assurance) 
* ESG Finance (Banque / Assurance) 
* Consolidation comptable (Banque / Assurance) 
* RPA / Machine Learning / IA for finance (Banque / Assurance) 
Parmi nos missions emblématiques : 
* Accompagner la transformation d’une direction financière, 
* Préparer une organisation pour répondre aux exigences du reporting ESG, 
* Répondre à des enjeux business d’alignement des reporting de consolidation et de gestion et refondre le processus de reporting, 
* Accompagner nos clients lors d’opérations exceptionnelles, dans un contexte de fusion / acquisition, par exemple, à la refonte du reporting et la réalisation de la reprise des historiques,  
* Améliorer le processus de clôture et de reporting dans un objectif de réduction des délais de publication sur le marché, 
* Appui à la performance et mise en place d’outils EPM, de consolidation ou de Data Visualisation : aider au choix et mettre en œuvre de nouveaux systèmes d’information financiers (Anaplan, Tagetik, SAP ou Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, …), 
* Reporting et consolidation : améliorer la production et l'analyse des données financières et opérationnelles, optimiser et automatiser les reporting. 
Votre profil
* Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 d'une école d'ingénieur ou de commerce, IEP ou 3ème cycle universitaire spécialisé en finance/gestion 
* Vous avez une expérience de 3 ans minimum en cabinet de conseil ou en entreprise, où vous avez déjà contribué à un ou plusieurs projets touchant les thématiques ou les outils évoqués (Consolidation comptable, FP&A, Fast close, E-Invoicing, Pilier 2, IA for Finance, SAP, Anaplan, etc.) 
* Vous disposez de bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse, êtes à l’écoute, rigoureux(se), et impactant(e) à l’oral 
* Vous êtes à l’aise dans des environnements exigeants, complexes et prêt à vous engager au service de nos clients 
* Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale, en français et en anglais 
Vos avantages 
* Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain. 
* Des possibilités d’apprentissage et de développement hors normes, grâce à notre plateforme de formation intelligente et notre culture du feedback continu. 
* Un cycle de performance stimulant, aligné avec le référentiel PwC Professional, pour vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs et viser l’excellence jour après jour. 
* Un cadre de travail positif et inclusif pour vous permettre d’être pleinement vous-même et de collaborer efficacement au service de nos clients (programmes de parentalité, d’équité femmes-hommes, de santé et bien-être Be Well, Work Well, d’inclusion LGBT+ et de maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap). 
Pour en savoir plus sur nos avantages, rendez-vous sur notre page dédiée. 
Notre processus de recrutement 
Pour vous permettre de vivre une expérience fluide et transparente, notre processus de recrutement se déroule en plusieurs étapes : 
* Évaluation en ligne avec un test d’anglais 
* Entretien RH 
* Rencontres avec les équipes opérationnelles (un ou plusieurs entretiens en physique) 
* Vérification des informations : avant l’embauche, un organisme spécialisé procédera à la vérification des éléments figurant sur votre CV

Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our people in operations consulting specialise in providing consulting services on optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. These individuals analyse client needs, develop operational strategies, and offer guidance and support to help clients streamline processes, improve productivity, and drive business performance.
As an operations consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad understanding of various aspects of operations consulting. You will provide comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. Working in this area, you will analyse client needs, develop operational solutions, and offer recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.
The Opportunity: 
As a Digital Operations, Senior Associate, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. You will work closely with Managers and senior team members to translate planning and readiness questions into analytical outputs that inform decision‑making. The role emphasizes strong analytical execution, clear communication of results, and an interest in how analytics is used in real operational decisions. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to: 
Analytical Problem Solving 
* Support structuring of operational, logistics, and planning challenges as analytical problems under uncertainty. 
* Contribute to analysis of trade‑offs involving capacity, inventory, risk, service levels, and timing. 
* Apply quantitative techniques with appropriate rigor based on guidance from senior team members. 
Applied Modelling & Analysis 
* Build and support quantitative analyses including Supply chain network and flow analysis, Inventory planning under uncertainty, Capacity, throughput, and bottleneck analysis, Scenario and probabilistic analysis using simulation 
* Support model testing, sensitivity analysis, and validation to ensure outputs are reliable and decision‑relevant. 
Technology & Tools 
* Develop and maintain analytics code, models, and supporting documentation. 
* Work with data from multiple systems and sources. 
* Support documentation of business rules, data requirements, process flows, and reporting logic. 
* Tools may include Python, R, and SQL; optimization solvers; simulation libraries; and enterprise or cloud data platforms. 
* Follow governed, auditable analytics and documentation practices. 
Team & Stakeholder Support 
* Work collaboratively within project teams to deliver high‑quality analytical outputs. 
* Support preparation of materials and insights for client discussions. 
* Proactively flag data, modelling, or assumption risks to senior team members. 
* Work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. 
What You'll Bring: 
Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:
* Degree in operations, industrial/systems engineering, computer science, or a closely related quantitative field. 
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in a relevant field. 
* Experience applying quantitative or analytical techniques to operations, supply chain, or planning problems in defense, manufacturing, or other asset‑intensive industries. 
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to data quality and assumptions. 
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms, system integration concepts, data architecture, and digital workflow enablement is an asset. 
* Candidates with military experience are encouraged to apply 
* PwC Canada is committed to cultivating an inclusive, hybrid work environment. Exact expectations for your team can be discussed with your interviewer.
Additional Requirements 
* As a requirement, a Security Clearance is mandatory for all staff who’ll be engaged on these assignments. Prior to applying, please review the Government of Canada website to ensure you meet the eligibility requirements to obtain this clearance. This’ll become a condition of your employment with PwC should you receive an offer from us. 
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas for non‑technical audiences. 
This newly created role reflects our commitment to growth and delivering distinctive value for our clients and stakeholders.
The salary range for this position is $84,700 - $134,700. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Job Description & Summary
PwC Österreich ist mit rund 1.500 Mitarbeitenden an 6 Standorten eines der größten Prüfungs- und Beratungsunternehmen des Landes. Wir setzen auf Menschen, die frische Perspektiven einbringen und aus neuen Ideen echte Erfolge machen. Starte jetzt deinen Weg.
KI-Agenten verändern, wie Unternehmen Kund:innen gewinnen, begleiten und binden. Die Gewinner werden nicht die sein, die am meisten automatisieren. Es werden die sein, die Technologie und menschliche Stärken am besten verbinden. In unserem Team Customer Transformation begleiten wir führende Unternehmen auf diesem Weg. Wir bauen kundennahe Wertströme in Marketing, Vertrieb und Service end-to-end neu auf: von der Strategie über das Zielbild bis zur Umsetzung.
Dabei erleben wir gerade einen grundlegenden Shift. CRM-Plattformen öffnen sich nach dem Headless-Prinzip, Frontends werden entkoppelt. Die Customer Journey findet zunehmend dort statt, wo Menschen ohnehin arbeiten und fragen: in KI-Assistenten und Agenten-Plattformen wie Claude oder ChatGPT. Deshalb arbeiten wir technologieoffen: Im Mittelpunkt steht der Nutzen für unsere Kund:innen, nicht das Tool. Unser Partner-Ökosystem wächst laufend.
Bei uns bist du nicht nur Teil eines Projekts. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für ein Thema und treibst es voran.
Deine Aufgaben bei uns im Team
* Gestalte gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen die Transformation zum Agentic Enterprise in Marketing, Sales und Service 
* Begleite unsere Kund:innen beim Wandel hin zu Headless- und agentischen Architekturen und arbeite an zukunftsfähigen Customer Journeys 
* Entwickle Zielbilder, Use Cases und Roadmaps und übersetze komplexe Fragestellungen in klare Konzepte und greifbare Business Cases 
* Übernimm Verantwortung von der Kundenakquise über die Angebotserstellung bis zur erfolgreichen Projektdurchführung 
* Konzipiere und moderiere Workshops mit Fachbereichen, IT und Management und begeistere Stakeholder bis auf Entscheider-Ebene für neue Wege 
* Verbinde Business und Technologie, bewerte Technologie-Optionen unabhängig und begleite die konzeptionelle Gestaltung und Umsetzung agentischer Lösungen 
* Unterstütze unsere Kund:innen bei Change, Adoption und Governance, damit die Transformation im Alltag ankommt 
* Treibe Themen aktiv voran und entwickle unser Leistungsportfolio und Partner-Ökosystem rund um Agentic Enterprise gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter
Das spricht dich an? Dann freuen wir uns, wenn du folgende Skills und Eigenschaften mitbringst:
* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft, Informatik, Technik, Kommunikation, Psychologie, Sozialwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im relevanten Umfeld 
* Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der Beratung, mit Bezug zu Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM oder Customer Experience 
* Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer relevanten Technologie und Neugier auf die anderen, zum Beispiel: * KI-Modelle & Agenten-Plattformen: z. B. Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI / ChatGPT, Google Cloud (Gemini, Vertex AI), AWS (z. B. Amazon Bedrock)

Job Description & Summary
PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Chaque jour, nous exerçons des métiers d’excellence pour concrétiser notre ambition : être utiles à nos clients et accélérateurs de mouvement. 
Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences. 
Ce que nous recherchons ? Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble. 
Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.
Au sein de notre entité Consulting, l’équipe CIO Advisory (100 collaborateurs) adresse les 3 enjeux majeurs des DSI et des directions de la Transformation de grands groupes internationaux et d’entreprises de taille intermédiaire en pleine croissance :
* Stratégie SI : imaginer et bâtir le SI du futur, créateur de valeur pérenne, aligné avec la stratégie de l’entreprise, sobre, plus urbanisé et catalysé par l’intelligence artificielle
Schémas directeurs SI-Métiers et Technologiques, Architecture SI / Cloud, Plan Stratégique IT, Green IT / IT-for-Green …
* Transformation de la filière informatique : adapter l’organisation et les modes de fonctionnement de la DSI (Support, Informatique et Coeur de métier) pour y intégrer au mieux les enjeux technologiques
Modèles opérationnels IT cibles, excellence opérationnelle, performance opérationnelle et économique de la DSI …
* Cadrage et pilotage des transformations SI / Métier : réussir l’exécution des transformations pour concrétiser le B-case
Gouvernance, structuration, sécurisation des choix technologiques, refonte de processus métier, accompagnement de programmes ERP…
Ce que vous pouvez attendre de nous
* Appuyer les comités de direction dans leur réflexion stratégique en intégrant toutes les dimensions d’une transformation (métier, technologique, data, process)
* Co-construire leur feuille de route et aligner les différents métiers de l’entreprise
* Repenser / optimiser les processus métiers
* Faire les bons choix de solutions, partenaires et de gouvernance
* Aligner la filière informatique aux besoins de transformation
* Structurer et piloter les projets de transformation dans une approche création de valeur et de maîtrise des risques
Ce que nous attendons de vous
* Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou d’un 3ème cycle universitaire
* Vous avez une forte appétence pour la technologie
* Vous souhaitez décliner la technologie au service des métiers
* Vous avez de très bonnes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse
* Vous êtes capable de vous intégrer dans une équipe dynamique et d’y apporter votre contribution : aide à la rédaction de propositions commerciales, structuration et formalisation de livrables, etc.
* Vous maîtrisez l’anglais pour travailler avec nos équipes et clients à l’international.
Ces avantages que nous vous offrons : 
* Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain. 
* Des possibilités d’apprentissage et de développement hors normes, grâce à notre plateforme de formation intelligente et notre culture du feedback continu. 
* Un cycle de performance stimulant, aligné avec le référentiel PwC Professional, pour vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs et viser l’excellence jour après jour.
* Un cadre de travail positif et inclusif pour vous permettre d’être pleinement vous-même et de collaborer efficacement au service de nos clients (programmes de parentalité, d’équité femmes-hommes, de santé et bien-être Be Well, Work Well, d’inclusion LGBT+ et de maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap). 
Pour en savoir plus sur nos avantages, rendez-vous sur notre page dédiée.
Notre processus de recrutement 
Pour vous permettre de vivre une expérience fluide et transparente, notre processus de recrutement se déroule en plusieurs étapes : 
* Évaluation en ligne avec un test de compétences et/ou un test d’anglais 
* Entretien RH 
* Rencontres avec les équipes opérationnelles (un ou plusieurs entretiens en physique) 
* Vérification des informations : avant l’embauche, un organisme spécialisé procédera à la vérification des éléments figurant sur votre CV
