Job Description & Summary
Contribute to creating a better tomorrow 
The only way we can tackle the challenges of this fast-changing world is with passionate people. Led by our purpose of building trust and solving important problems, we come together at PwC to address the biggest issues facing the world in a way that drives positive impact. Are you eager to join a team fueled by open and curious minds? People who are passionate about their work and create new solutions for a new day? Then you’re in the right place. 
Bring your talent. Learn new skills. Make a positive impact 
PwC Advisory is a network of multiple possibilities - where you want to make an impact is always up to you. Under the expert stewardship of our Advisory experts, you’ll delve into the inner workings of companies to find the best solutions for any challenge they might have.
From the excitement of deals to the complexities of consulting and the fascinating realm of risks and threats in forensics, you’ll help clients nurture trust and maintain their evolutionary edge, today and into the future. Now that’s making a difference. 
Do you want to be part of our PwC Pharma & Life Sciences (PLS) team & practice?
PwC is looking for a talented professional with experience in PLS business consultancy to join our PwC Management Consulting department. You will join a team tackling complex challenges spanning clinical development, business operations, quality, and value-based health care. Our strategy is to build trust, deliver sustained outcomes and help clients solve their most important problems by combining human ingenuity and understanding with the right technology. First, you’ll manage R&D or Quality projects at Pharma or Biotech clients, including strategic assessment, developing recommendations and implementation of new operating models. Second, you’ll actively contribute to the development of PwC center of excellence. This means contributing to business development activities including service offering, scanning of the market and account planning, and supporting market development activities including writing thought leadership, point-of-view papers and/or blog posts. 
What you’ll learn and do
As a Senior Consultant Research & Development, your main responsibility will be on any or a combination of the following activities:
* Strategic Advising: Providing strategic advice to pharmaceutical and life sciences companies and the healthcare sector to enhance their R&D, Quality and/or value-based healthcare initiatives. This can involve evaluating current R&D, Quality and/or value-based healthcare practices and recommending improvements.
* Process Optimization: Identifying inefficiencies in the R&D pipeline and Quality processes and suggesting process improvements to enhance productivity and reduce time-to-market for new drugs and therapies.
* Technology implementation & innovation Management: Assisting clients by managing their innovation processes through identifying opportunities for drug development and adopting new technologies. This could include implementing efficiencies and enhancing quality processes through technology. As well as, supporting clients by generating insights on ways to improve care pathways and work on enhancing organizational readiness for value-based healthcare.
* Data Analysis and Insights: Analysing data to provide insights that can drive decision-making in health industry and healthcare projects. This involves leveraging advanced analytics and digital tools.
* Project Management: Leading and managing projects, ensuring they are delivered on time and within budget while meeting client expectations. Identify and mitigate risks to ensure successful outcomes.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Facilitating collaboration among various stakeholders, including researchers, healthcare providers and professionals, regulatory bodies, third party payers and authorities, and (other business units in) industry (pharma, medtech, biotech, data/digital), to ensure alignment and successful project outcomes.
* Change Management: Supporting clients in managing the organizational changes that come with implementing new R&D & Quality strategies or technologies, and transformation efforts towards value-based healthcare principles.
Who you are:
* Master’s degree in biomedical sciences, (health) economics, (bio-)engineering, business administration, sciences or comparable by experience 
* Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in consultancy and/or the Life Science industry
* Knowledge of (pre-)clinical regulations as well as quality and risk management.
* Know-how and interest in trends (science/data/digital) within Life Science & Healthcare industry 
* Ability to combine specialist technical knowledge, strong analytical and problem-solving skills with consulting skills (project management, presentation and communication skills, etc.) while working directly with management and employees on the clients’ premises 
* Fluent in English, and Dutch or French 
* Flexibility to work in different environments and locations and easily acquire new skills and expertise
* Autonomous and proactive attitude with an entrepreneurship mindset.
Life at PwC Belgium
Our culture and workplace are something we’re proud of. Here’s a sneak peek at what life at PwC looks like:
* Flexible work patterns: Achieve the perfect balance between office and home life with our flexible hybrid work arrangements and family-friendly schemes.
* Lifelong learning: Grow with us! Take advantage of our diverse training opportunities and exciting career pathways to explore new disciplines and expertise.
* Flexible rewards: Tailor your benefits to suit your lifestyle with our customizable rewards plan.
* Sustainable mobility: Choose eco-friendly mobility options, from our soon-to-be fully electrified fleet to public transport, shared cars, ebikes, and more.
* Inclusive culture: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive workplace that values and celebrates every individual's contributions.
* Wellbeing focus: Enjoy a positive environment with our comprehensive wellbeing programs, engaging sports communities, and confidential support for all your professional and personal challenges.
* Global network: Expand your horizons with opportunities to work abroad and tap into extensive industry expertise within the PwC network.
Let’s build something great together. What are you waiting for?

At PwC, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic environment. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all candidates and employees, regardless of race, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation and strengthens our ability to serve our people, clients and communities. Join us in fostering a culture where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to achieve their full potential.
 Additionally, we provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, in accordance with applicable laws.

jd_text:
Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY-Parthenon, you can be sure that you are making a difference - for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you will have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize or broaden your expertise, you are in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY-Parthenon provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.
Your new job | About your main responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy and Execution team, you play a key role in helping clients navigate complex transactions and transformations. You work across the full deal lifecycle, covering divestments, integrations, and value creation. In this role, you support decisions that directly impact business performance and long-term value, working with leading corporates and investors on high-impact, often large-scale transactions.
We work end-to-end across the transaction lifecycle. On the sell side, we help clients prepare and separate businesses, from defining the transaction perimeter and designing standalone operating models and costing to executing the carve-out. On the buy side, we work with clients to evaluate (carved-out) acquisition targets, define integration strategies, and realize synergies. Beyond the transaction, we continue to work alongside clients to realize change, challenge status quo, capture synergies, and deliver measurable improvements in performance.
You work directly with clients on carve-outs, integrations, and transformations by structuring complex topics, advising on key decisions, and ensuring plans are translated into tangible results.
In your role, you:
* Lead and execute in-depth analyses on business performance, cost structures, and operations, translating comingled data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
* Structure complex problems and translate them into clear, actionable solutions, guiding workstreams from initial hypothesis through to implementation
* Assess organizational setups and develop robust solutions, including standalone financials, operating model designs, and separation or integration approaches
* Build robust business cases for synergies, cost optimization, and broader value creation opportunities, and support their realization
* Translate strategic priorities into concrete actions and drive their execution to deliver tangible results
* Work closely with clients to guide decision-making, align stakeholders, and maintain momentum in fast-paced, high-impact environments
* Support and develop junior team members through coaching, feedback, and hands-on guidance, helping them grow while ensuring long-term, high-quality delivery
* Collaborate with managers and senior stakeholders to refine hypotheses, challenge thinking, and steer overall project delivery
Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
Your team
In this role, you work on mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures, supporting clients on decisions that materially impact their business. This can range from targeted acquisitions to more complex, large-scale transactions. You operate at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, contributing to topics such as transaction strategy, operational due diligence, value creation, divestitures, and integrations, with a clear focus on delivering tangible outcomes.
You are part of a close-knit team with a shared ambition, while bringing together a variety of backgrounds and perspectives. We work in a collaborative and supportive environment, where you learn from experienced colleagues, receive regular feedback, and have the opportunity to develop yourself quickly.
Your office: Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.
Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution
At EY-Parthenon, we are committed to diversity and inclusion, creating an environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Our values of integrity, respect, and excellence guide us in everything we do. To be successful in this role we typically see: 
* A minimum of 2-3 years relevant M&A experience or corporate transformations, preferably from corporate M&A teams, strategy consulting or big 4 firms 
* A Master’s degree in a Science, Engineering or Business Administration related field 
* Knowledge of and experience with operational aspects of M&A including due diligence, planning, synergies, value creation and / or post close transformation 
* An aptitude for qualitative and quantitative analysis and the ability to link business strategy to performance 
* The ability to lead and communicate effectively with sound reasoning, preferably in client facing roles 
Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment
* A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).
* You receive a permanent contract for 40 hours.
* A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
* 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind.
* With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.
* At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you are working from the office, at a client, or from home, we make sure you have a well-equipped home office.
* The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
* The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
* You have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
* Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That is why you have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
* A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.
All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it is important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here.
Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process
1. Application: For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.
2. First interview: Before the interview, we will ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We will discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.
3. Second interview: If we see a match and you are still enthusiastic, we will invite you for a second interview. We will dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics, and you’ll be presented with a business case to assess your problem solving skills, outside the box-thinking and structured approach.
4. Third interview: You will meet two future colleagues and complete another case interview.
5. Fourth interview: A final conversation with the partner.
We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!
Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.

Your team

Senior Consultant – Transformation Programme Delivery
The Opportunity
Do you want to play a key role in delivering complex, enterprise-scale transformation? As a Senior Consultant in Transformation Programme Delivery, you’ll help clients mobilise and manage and oversee critical programmes, turning strategic ambitions into structured, executable delivery plans. Working alongside managers and directors, you will play a key part in delivering complex, high-profile transformation programmes, helping clients achieve successful outcomes through effective planning, governance, stakeholder engagement, and performance management.
About Transformation Programme Management
Transformation Programme Delivery helps clients mobilise, govern and successfully deliver complex transformation. The practice provides programme, project and portfolio management capability across the transformation lifecycle, establishing effective delivery structures and governance, managing risks and dependencies, supporting programme recovery and maintaining focus on the achievement of strategic outcomes and value.
We establish and mobilise the Transformation Management Office (TMO) with governance to steer decisions. We lead transformation programmes end‑to‑end, managing risks, decisions, and benefits realisation.
Your Key Responsibilities
* Programme Delivery - support the successful delivery of client projects by contributing to core Programme delivery process and coordinating the work of multidisciplinary EY delivery teams
* Programme Mobilisation – Assist in setting up TMO/PMO structures, governance packs, and reporting templates.
* Producing and reviewing Programme related reports, presentations and management information
* Managing aspects of resources, financial monitoring and delivery reporting
* Building effective client relationships– Coordinate workshops, prepare materials, and manage day-to-day client interactions.
* Risk & Assurance – Maintain RAID logs and support quality reviews.
* Team Contribution – Deliver high-quality outputs, coach junior colleagues, and actively participate in practice development.
Skills and attributes for success
* Core Project Management skills; Project planning, Integrated planning and milestone management, RAID and dependency management
* Ability to coordinate and manage packages of work and core TPD processes (e.g. risk management).
* Strong analytical and financial skills; comfortable with modelling and data interpretation.
* Familiarity with programme financial management and commercial awareness.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills; confident preparing and presenting to stakeholders.
* Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail and quality.
To qualify for the role, you must have
* Proven experience in industry and consulting, driving complex business transformation initiatives
* Over 3 years of experience in programme delivery roles, ensuring successful outcomes
* Exposure to recognised Programme Delivery Methods (e.g., PRINCE2, MSP)
* Ability to produce clear plans, reports, and presentations.
* Degree (or equivalent experience) and strong written/spoken English.
Ideally, you’ll also have
* A curious mindset to understand how things work and a collaborative approach to working out how to make them work better.
* Progress toward professional qualifications (e.g., PRINCE2, APM, MSP, MoP, Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, ISEB/BCS Business Analysis).
* Awareness of benefits realisation frameworks and value tracking.
Additional Information – Transformation Delivery Overview
TPD sits within Business Transformation, working end-to-end from shaping to execution alongside colleagues in Agile Delivery, Technology Consulting, and Strategy & Transactions. We build and orchestrate enterprise transformation programmes with Transformation Realised as the core delivery methodology.
What we offer
You’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the scale, support, and inclusive culture to become the best version of yourself. We provide continuous learning, flexibility, and coaching to help you grow, along with a competitive rewards package.
EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jd_text:
CONSULTANT – Industria 4.0 & Business Incentives (Milano)
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In un contesto in cui l'intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo di lavorare, crediamo che il vero valore nasca dalla capacità delle persone di interpretare la complessità, costruire relazioni di fiducia e trasformare le opportunità tecnologiche in impatto concreto per clienti, organizzazioni e società. 
Perché candidarsi in EY?
Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti: 
* Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto.
* Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita.
* Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali.
* Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta; 
* Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.
* Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.
Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi? 
Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un/una Consultant nel team di Industria 4.0 & Business Incentives
Il team Finance della Service Line Business Consulting è dedicato alla Finance Transformation e ad attività legate a incentivi e contributi alle imprese. Ti interfaccerai con clienti nazionali e internazionali appartenenti a diversi settori (manufacturing, energy, pharma, automotive, telecomunicazioni, ecc.), contribuendo allo sviluppo e alla gestione dei progetti.
Avrai l’opportunità di lavorare su progetti caratterizzati da una forte componente tecnica, economico-finanziaria e normativa, supportando le aziende nell’analisi e nella valorizzazione dei propri investimenti. Lavorerai al fianco di professionisti esperti per clienti di grandi dimensioni, crescendo rapidamente sul campo.
Nello specifico contribuirai all’implementazione dei servizi Finance connessi agli incentivi agli investimenti e all’innovazione, con particolare riferimento a Transizione 5.0 e Patent Box per le aziende clienti.
Chi stiamo cercando? Persone con:
* Laurea magistrale in materie tecnico-scientifiche (preferibilmente in Ingegneria) o in Economia
* Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative
* Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office (con particolare riferimento a Excel e Power Point)
* Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese
Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza pregressa in contesti operanti nella Finanza Agevolata.
In EY potrai:
* Accelerare le tue competenze: grazie a programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro e a strumenti AI che automatizzano attività ripetitive, potrai dedicare più tempo all'analisi, alla consulenza, all'innovazione e alla costruzione di relazioni professionali ad alto impatto.
* Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: lavora in team internazionali e multidisciplinari, confrontandoti con prospettive diverse e contribuendo a sviluppare soluzioni che combinano tecnologia, competenze specialistiche e intuizione umana.
* Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.
Avrai infine l’opportunità di:
* accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
* partecipare a programmi di leadership.
Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 29.500€ e 33.000€, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione. Per la specifica posizione è previsto un bonus al raggiungimento di obiettivi preventivamente comunicati e concordati.
In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico:
Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.
Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in.
Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.
Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.
EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world 
In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo un Team di oltre 9.000 persone, distribuite in 20 città in tutta Italia. 
Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

jd_text:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 
Join EY and help to build a better working world. 
Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.
Your new job | About your main responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant within the EY-Parthenon Strategy Practice, you will play a central role in shaping strategic recommendations and helping clients put them into practice. You will independently own analyses and workstreams, work with senior client stakeholders and support junior colleagues. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on delivery across corporate strategy, commercial growth, digital, data and AI.
* Own analyses and defined workstreams from problem definition through recommendation.
* Develop fact-based perspectives on markets, customers, competitors and business performance.
* Translate strategic choices into practical priorities and actionable roadmaps.
* Engage with client stakeholders and communicate complex insights clearly.
* Support and coach Consultants while contributing to team quality and development.
* Realize real impact by driving on-the-ground change at our clients
Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
EY-Parthenon helps boards, management teams and private equity investors make clear choices about where to play, how to win and which capabilities are needed to create sustainable value. The team combines deep market, customer and competitive insights with expertise across corporate and commercial strategy, digital, data and AI. Strategic choices are translated into clear priorities and actionable roadmaps, working alongside clients to bring them to life and bridge the gap between strategy and execution. You will develop through hands-on coaching, structured learning and collaboration with experienced colleagues across EY-Parthenon and the wider EY network, in an inclusive, team-based environment that values curiosity, different perspectives and practical impact.
Your office: Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.
Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution
* Approximately 2-5 years of relevant professional experience.
* Demonstrated ability to independently own analyses or workstreams.
* Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience or a strong interest in strategy, digital, data, AI, commercial growth or transformation.
* A proactive, adaptable and collaborative mindset.
Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment
* A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).
* You’ll receive a contract for 40 hours.
* A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
* 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind.
* With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.
* At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.
* The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
* The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
* You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
* Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
* A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.
All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here.
Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process
* For this role, we ask you to submit your CV along with a motivation letter, where we welcome the use of AI tools as long as your personal motivation and authentic voice remain clearly visible.
* After an initial screening, you will be invited to complete an online assessment.
* This is followed by a first interview focused on getting to know each other, discussing your ambitions, and providing further insight into the role and team.
* Successful candidates will proceed to two case interviews, designed to assess both technological knowledge and capability, as well as commercial acumen.
* The process concludes with a final interview.
* If it’s a match on both sides, we’ll be happy to move forward quickly and share an offer, and welcome you to the team.
Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.
EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. 
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. 
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories

jd_text:
Chez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance. Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur.
Notre Opportunité :
L’équipe Digital & Agile Transformation (D&AT) a pour mission d’accompagner la transformation digitale des Directions Générales, des Directions métiers et des Directions SI et Innovation. Les consultant(e)s D&AT interviennent sur l’intégralité de la chaîne de valeur d’un programme ou d’un projet, auprès de clients des secteurs privé comme public.
L’équipe D&AT répond à l’ensemble des besoins de transformation de ses clients :
* Transformation digitale de bout-en-bout ;
* Transformation organisationnelle et méthodologique des organisations (Agilité, mode produit, DevOps,etc.) ;
* Accompagnement des Directions des Systèmes d’Information dans le day to day ;
* Green IT & Numérique Responsable ou comment rendre nos clients plus responsables ;
* Innovation, Technologies & Intelligence Artificielle
Cela s’accompagne d’une approche sectorielle incarnée au travers de communautés dédiées : secteur public, énergie, mobilité, retail and consumer products et luxe, …
Vos principales responsabilités :
En lien avec l’offre de services de D&AT, vous contribuerez en tant que consultant(e) senior, auprès de l’un de nos clients, à une ou plusieurs de ces missions, sous la supervision d’un(e) manager de mission :
* Accompagner les programmes/projets/produits/plateformes digitaux de bout en bout, en s’appuyant notamment sur les solutions du marché ;
* Cadrer et faciliter la transformation organisationnelle et méthodologique (Scrum Master/Product Owner/Product Manager/Coach Agile, mise en œuvre de l’Agilité puis son passage à l’échelle) ;
* Accompagner les DSI / Direction du numérique dans leurs opérations au travers de la définition et du suivi de feuilles de route de transformation ;
* Faire du « numérique responsable » un volet de la transformation numérique de nos clients ;
* Accompagner l’innovation technologique et sa diffusion au sein des organisations (Gen IA, Low code/no code, etc.).
En complément des missions réalisées auprès de nos clients, vous serez amené(e)s à participer au développement de D&AT et, plus largement de EY, par le biais de contributions internes (animation de la vie de l’équipe, implication au sein d’une communauté thématique ou d’un réseau, etc.)
En tant que consultant(e) senior, sous la supervision et avec l’accompagnement d’un manager de mission, vous serez amené(e) à gérer en pleine autonomie les activités et livrables qui relèvent de votre périmètre d’intervention, faire valoir une expertise sectorielle ou méthodologique, ainsi que faire rayonner l’excellence de la marque EY au quotidien.
Vos Compétences pour réussir :
De formation supérieure, vous possédez une expérience d’au minimum 2 ans dans la transformation digitale en cabinet de conseil ou au sein d’un grand groupe international sur du pilotage de programme ou de projet de transformation numérique / AMOA SI.
Vous disposez également d’une expérience éprouvée des méthodologies type Agile, Scrum Master, Product Owner, SAFe Agilist ainsi qu’une connaissance approfondie des outils et tendances technologiques : tech sustainability, Gen AI…
Ce que nous recherchons :
Vous avez envie de rejoindre un collectif fort et engagé au service de nos clients
Vous disposez des qualités suivantes :
* Ecoute, analyse et synthèse ;
* Esprit d’équipe et sens relationnel ;
* Curiosité et adaptabilité ;
* Rigueur et organisation.
Votre anglais est courant (écrit et oral).
Ce que nous vous offrons :
* Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.
* Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY.
* L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à nos programmes de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U.
* Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo.
* De nombreux autres avantages : des primes de cooptation, un abonnement sportif Wellpass à tarif préférentiel, l’entrée gratuite aux musées du Louvre et Eugène-Delacroix, un accès privilégié à l’Opéra de Paris…
Etes-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.
Processus de recrutement :
* Notre processus de recrutement est composé de 4 entretiens (RH, métier, étude de cas et un entretien de validation avec un(e) Associé(e)), menés à distance et en présentiel.
* Pour garantir une expérience équitable et inclusive durant le processus de recrutement, n'hésitez pas à nous informer dès que possible de tout aménagement dont vous pourriez avoir besoin.
Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.
EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 
Join EY and help to build a better working world. 
Senior Consultant, Climate Change and Sustainability Services (CCaSS)
General Information
Location: Dublin
Available for Work Visa Sponsorship: YES
Business Area: FSO Assurance
Contract Type: Full-Time – Permanent
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Today, a company’s value is increasingly reflected not just in its short-term financial performance, but also in its ability to deliver value to multiple stakeholders, including consumers, employees, governments, and wider society. How organisations respond to global challenges such as climate change and sustainability are critical in how they deliver and demonstrate value to stakeholders.
The Opportunity:
In response to this, we are looking for high-performing, innovative and enthusiastic candidates to join our growing team of climate change and sustainability finance professionals who are building a better working world by helping global organisations to identify, measure, deliver and report on the climate and sustainability issues which are most relevant to create long-term value for business. 
Successful candidates will join the EY Financial Service’s Climate Change and Sustainability Services team. Within Climate Change and Sustainability Services (CCaSS), our focus areas are climate change, sustainability assurance and advisory, navigating the regulatory landscape, and creating long term value. There will be opportunities to work across the focus areas within the wider business.
The Role:
This role will place you at the heart of a high-energy, agile team that is committed to helping clients build long-term sustainable businesses. This opportunity will enable you to work with leading financial institutions to deliver better outcomes on some of the world’s most pressing climate and sustainability issues. You will interact with EY colleagues globally and work across our different sectors and business activities.
EY is looking for Senior Consultant Candidates with Auditing, Data & Analytics or Regulatory experience to help our clients respond to issues across the sustainability agenda. Key service areas include:
* Sustainability reporting and assurance.
* Sustainability Data and Implementation.
* Sustainability strategy.
* Climate and Nature change risk.
* Carbon measurement and management.
* ESG advisory.
* Responsible investment.
Your key responsibilities:
You’ll spend most of your time in assisting clients to identify, measure, and manage their business and reporting risks as they transit their organizations in response to changing government environmental regulations and new trends in sustainability management and reporting. You enjoy actively contributing to the growth and development of the CCaSS practice by taking operational responsibility and accountability for engagement team support and delivery.
Skills and attributes for success:
As a Senior Consultant / Assistant Manager within the team, you will be expected to consult, so it is essential that you bring the competencies that will allow you to do so.
* Intellectual curiosity.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills, verbal, written but also active listening.
* Solution orientated including models and accelerators.
* Proven experience acting as an AI enabler, helping translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable solutions within a regulated environment.
* Background in Risk and Regulatory functions, with a strong understanding of compliance, governance, and control frameworks.
* Experience working within or alongside central banks, regulators, or related institutions (e.g., WAM or similar financial/monetary authorities), with insight into supervisory expectations and policy-driven environments.
Qualifications:
We welcome applicants from a wide range of backgrounds, but are particularly interested in individuals that have the following qualifications:
* Track record of success from 2-4 years of relevant experience in sustainability / ESG at a blue-chip firm, sustainability consultancy, investment firm or other relevant organisation.
* ACA or ACCA (or equivalent) qualification.
* A keen interest in, and understanding of ESG as it relates to financial services (banking, wealth and asset management, insurance, and/or private equity).
* A strong understanding of any, or a combination of the topics that we cover in our team as listed above.
* Risk management and modelling experience.
* Strong academic record including a relevant degree.
* Experience running or contributing to a range of projects.
What we look for
We’re interested in leaders with a genuine creative vision and the confidence to make it happen. You can expect plenty of autonomy in this role, so you’ll also need the ability to take initiative and seek out opportunities to improve our current relationships and processes.
What working at EY offers 
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive benefits package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs: covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer: 
* Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around. 
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career. 
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you. 
All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include: 
* Pension 
* Discounted health insurance
* Web Doctor – Free unlimited online GP consultations for you and your family 
* The purchase of additional annual leave
* Hybrid Working 
* Free Gym membership
* Travel Pass
* Maternity & Paternity leave
* Bike to work Scheme
* Recognition Awards
* Cash incentives for referrals
* Work Mobile 
* Tech MBA paid by EY
* Wellness rooms available in some offices
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance. 
Career Progression 
* When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one. 
* Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
* As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
* Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
* Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

jd_text:

Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Unser Bereich Financial Services fokussiert sich auf Finanzdienstleistungen und unterstützt Banken, Versicherungen und Asset Manager dabei, in einer sich stets verändernden und schnelllebigen Welt erfolgreich zu sein.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres interdisziplinären Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Transformation Hubs in München, Stuttgart, Berlin, Hamburg, Frankfurt/Main, Düsseldorf oder Köln berätst du führende Finanzinstitute, Zentralbanken und Aufsichtsbehörden an der Schnittstelle von Regulatorik, Geschäftsprozessen und digitaler Innovation. Du gestaltest die Zukunft der Risikomanagement- und Compliance-Funktionen aktiv mit, indem du innovative Technologien und datengetriebene Lösungen entwickelst und umsetzt. In dieser Rolle begleitest du unsere Kund:innen durch Transformationsprogramme und setzt durch deine Arbeit innovative Maßstäbe und Impulse für die digitale Weiterentwicklung der Finanzbranche. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
* Beratung unserer Kund:innen bei strategischen Neuausrichtungen und Modernisierungen ihrer Aufsichts-, Risk- und Compliance-bereiche. Dabei agierst du als Bindeglied zwischen fachlichen Anforderungen und dem gezielten Einsatz moderner Technologien
* Begleitung anspruchsvoller Transformationsvorhaben von der Strategie, über die Konzeption hin bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung, sowie Entwicklung präziser Fachkonzepte für die Strukturierung und Weiterentwicklung innovativer Geschäftsmodelle und Prozesse in den Bereichen Risk, KYC und AML
* Auswahl und Einführung marktführender SupTech und RegTech Lösungen, sowie moderner Risk und Compliance Anwendungen und Sicherstellung von einer erfolgreichen Integration in die Organisation. Zudem Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Serviceportfolios im Bereich Regulatory, Risk und Compliance Technology
* Entwicklung tragfähiger Konzepte für den Umgang mit Daten für Risk und Compliance und Unterstützung unserer Kund:innen, Daten gezielt für geschäftliche und regulatorische Entscheidungen nutzbar zu machen
Dein Skillset
* Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Finance, Wirtschaftsrecht, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit Schwerpunkt auf Finanzmärkte, BWL, Risikomanagement oder Unternehmensführung. Erste relevante Berufserfahrung im Beratungsumfeld, bei Finanzdienstleistern, Aufsichtsbehörden oder Fin-/RegTechs – idealerweise mit Bezug zu regulatorischen Prozessen, Risikomanagement oder Compliance
* Starkes Interesse an der digitalen Transformation der Finanzbranche, Fin- & Regtechs und daran, wie moderne Technologien und datenbasierte Ansätze zukunftsgerichtete Veränderungen in Risk und Compliance unterstützen
* Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau) und Englisch
Dein Mindset
* Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
* Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
* Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.

Weitere Informationen zu Financial Services findest du hier.

Bei EY leben wir Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen. Sag uns gerne frühzeitig Bescheid, wenn wir dich hinsichtlich eines barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozesses unterstützen können.

jd_text:
La oportunidad:
Consultor Senior de Valuación y Riesgos Financieros
Sobre EY México:
EY es una de las firmas de servicios profesionales más grandes del mundo, comprometida con la construcción de un mejor mundo de trabajo. En EY México ayudamos a organizaciones líderes a resolver desafíos complejos mediante soluciones innovadoras, tecnología y talento de primer nivel. Nuestro entorno fomenta el desarrollo profesional continuo, la colaboración y la excelencia técnica, permitiendo que nuestros profesionales generen un impacto significativo en clientes, equipos y comunidades.
Sobre FAAS:
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) es una práctica especializada dentro de Assurance que ayuda a las organizaciones a enfrentar retos contables, financieros y regulatorios. Nuestro equipo asesora a compañías de diversas industrias en la aplicación de normas contables, valuación de instrumentos financieros, gestión de riesgos, transacciones complejas y reporteo financiero, contribuyendo a la toma de decisiones estratégicas y al cumplimiento de estándares nacionales e internacionales.
Acerca del rol:
Buscamos un Consultor Senior de Valuación y Riesgos Financieros para integrarse a nuestro equipo especializado en instrumentos financieros y quantitative finance. Esta posición brinda la oportunidad de trabajar con clientes de auditoría y consultoría de diversos sectores, participando en proyectos relacionados con valuación de instrumentos financieros, análisis cuantitativo, gestión de riesgos y tratamientos contables bajo distintos marcos normativos.
El profesional será responsable de desarrollar análisis técnicos complejos, elaborar entregables de alta calidad, colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios y contribuir activamente al éxito de los proyectos mediante una sólida combinación de conocimientos financieros, habilidades analíticas y orientación al cliente.
Requerimientos y actividades
Actividades:
* Participar en la valuación de instrumentos financieros y derivados mediante metodologías cuantitativas y modelos financieros.
* Analizar información de mercado, indicadores económicos y variables financieras para soportar ejercicios de valuación y riesgo.
* Desarrollar y ejecutar modelos financieros, regresiones y análisis estadísticos utilizando herramientas especializadas.
* Interpretar contratos financieros, documentación técnica y normativa aplicable para evaluar impactos contables y financieros.
* Elaborar memorandos técnicos, informes, reportes y presentaciones ejecutivas para clientes y equipos internos.
* Participar en proyectos relacionados con gestión de riesgos financieros, fair value, impairment y otros temas especializados.
* Colaborar con gerentes y socios en la atención a clientes, asegurando el cumplimiento de entregables y fechas compromiso.
* Guiar y apoyar a profesionales junior en actividades técnicas y revisión de trabajos. 
Requerimientos:
* Licenciatura concluida en Economía, Finanzas, Actuaría, Ingeniería Financiera o carreras afines.
* Experiencia de 2 a 3 años en instituciones financieras, banca, consultoría financiera, valuación o áreas relacionadas.
* Nivel de inglés intermedio o superior.
* Dominio avanzado de Excel.
* Conocimiento de Python y/o R para análisis cuantitativo y modelación financiera.
* Experiencia en valuación de instrumentos financieros, derivados o gestión de riesgos financieros.
* Conocimientos contables relacionados con instrumentos financieros bajo IFRS, US GAAP u otros marcos normativos relevantes.
* Capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente y trabajar de forma autónoma.
* Excelentes habilidades analíticas, atención al detalle y orientación a resultados.
* Deseable: CFA Nivel I o certificaciones financieras equivalentes.
Competencias clave:
* Pensamiento crítico y resolución de problemas.
* Adaptabilidad y aprendizaje continuo.
* Comunicación efectiva.
* Orientación al cliente.
* Colaboración y trabajo en equipo.
* Conocimiento técnico financiero y contable.
* Curiosidad intelectual y mentalidad analítica.
* Inteligencia emocional y construcción de relaciones.
* Integridad y compromiso con la calidad.
Lo que ofrecemos:
En EY México valoramos a nuestros colaboradores y ofrecemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, dinámico y orientado al desarrollo profesional. Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con especialistas líderes en quantitative finance y riesgos financieros, participar en proyectos de alto impacto para clientes nacionales e internacionales y acceder a programas de capacitación continua, certificaciones y crecimiento profesional.
Además, ofrecemos un paquete competitivo de compensación y beneficios, esquemas de trabajo flexibles y una cultura basada en colaboración, innovación y bienestar integral.
Forma parte de EY y desarrolla tu carrera en uno de los equipos más especializados de instrumentos financieros y riesgos del mercado.
En EY México la diversidad, equidad e inclusión son un imperativo para nuestra organización. Nuestros procesos de reclutamiento y selección son acordes a lo establecido en la legislación laboral, razón por la cual, no se discrimina en función de las categorías protegidas en derechos humanos aplicables a la firma. Igualmente, en conformidad con el artículo 5 de la Ley Federal para Prevenir y Eliminar la Discriminación no se entenderá como discriminación la distinción basada en criterios razonables, proporcionales y objetivos cuya finalidad no sea el menoscabo de derechos. Todos los datos sensibles proporcionados a EY en el proceso de reclutamiento y de manera posterior son protegidos de conformidad con la Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en posesión de los particulares. Finalmente, en caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable en el proceso de postulación favor de especificarlo.

jd_text:
Zeker van je impact vandaag. Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen. 
Bij EY weet je zeker dat je het verschil maakt: voor je klant, de samenleving, je collega én je eigen ontwikkeling. Tegelijk krijg je de vrijheid om te werken op een manier die bij jouw leven past. Of je nu kiest voor verdieping, verbreding of leiderschap: jij hebt de regie. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s in een open en vertrouwde cultuur ga je elke dag voor het hoogst haalbare. Groot in mogelijkheden, vriendelijk in samenwerking. EY zorgt voor de middelen die je nodig hebt je carrière verder vorm te geven en impact te maken binnen jouw vakgebied. 
Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Als Senior Consultant Leiderschap & Organisatietransformatie maak je deel uit van het People Consulting team. 
In deze rol help je organisaties bij complexe verander- en transformatievraagstukken. Je combineert expertise op het gebied van leiderschap, verandermanagement, cultuur en organisatieontwikkeling om duurzame verandering te realiseren. 
* 
Technische vaardigheden op het gebied van leiderschap, verandermanagement, en organisatieontwikkeling toepassen om teams en organisaties te begeleiden tijdens complexe transformaties, reorganisaties en verandertrajecten. 
* 
Het analyseren en beoordelen van organisatievraagstukken op het gebied van leiderschap, cultuur, gedrag en verandering en deze vertalen naar concrete interventies. 
* 
Het ontwerpen, voorbereiden en faciliteren van workshops bij klanten; denk aan leiderschapsteams, managementteams en andere belangrijke stakeholders binnen verander- en transformatieprogramma's. 
* 
Verbinding zoeken met je klanten, en het proactief onderhouden en opbouwen van duurzame relaties. Je ziet en benut commerciële kansen. 
* 
Zorgen voor draagvlak bij senior stakeholders voor impactvolle veranderinitiatieven en het ondersteunen van leiders bij het succesvol realiseren van transformaties. 
* 
Bijdragen aan het continu verbeteren en ontwikkelen van onze producten en diensten, met name op het gebied van teamdynamiek, leiderschap, cultuurontwikkeling en organisatietransformatie. 
Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor 
Jouw team 
De afdeling People Consulting bestaat uit 40 HR- en verandermanagementprofessionals die ten minste één ding gemeen hebben; We hebben een mensgerichte mindset en plaatsen de mens centraal in onze opdrachten om een blijvende impact voor onze klanten te maken. We werken nauw samen over onze competenties heen om duurzame resultaten voor de klant te realiseren. De competenties binnen ons team zijn Change Experience, HR Transformation, Leadership & Culture, Digital HR, Talent & Skills, Organization & Workforce Transformation & AI Adoption. 
Jouw expertise speelt een sleutelrol in het verder uitbouwen van onze proposities op het gebied van leiderschap, verandermanagement en organisatietransformatie. Als Senior Consultant Leiderschap en organisatietransformatie help je organisaties bij het ontwikkelen van sterk leiderschap en effectieve leiderschapsteams, begeleid je cultuurverandering tijdens transformaties en ondersteun je teams om duurzaam op hoog niveau te presteren. Je komt terecht in een team met diverse achtergronden, waaronder topsport en defensie. 
Jouw kantoor 
Amsterdam 
Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden maar liefst 1500 mensen per dag bij binnenkomst verwelkomd. Voor een adembenemend uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. Samenwerken krijgt door de Wavespace een nieuwe betekenis. Deze High-Tech omgeving brengt wereldwijd klanten en collega’s virtueel samen. 
Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage 
* 
Heeft bij voorkeur een relevante masteropleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Organisatiepsychologie, Bedrijfskunde, HR of Verandermanagement. 
* 
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in consulting, verandermanagement, organisatietransformatie of leiderschapsontwikkeling. 
* 
Sterke expertise op het gebied van leiderschap, organisatieverandering, cultuur en teamdynamiek, opgedaan in bijvoorbeeld topsport, defensie of een andere relevante context. 
* 
Je begrijpt hoe leiderschap, gedrag en cultuur bijdragen aan het succesvol realiseren van organisatieverandering. 
* 
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel gesproken als geschreven. 
* 
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het opstellen van hoogwaardige rapporten, papers en presentaties, met een scherp oog voor detail. 
* 
Je bent in staat complexe organisatievraagstukken te analyseren en te vertalen naar concrete en uitvoerbare oplossingen. 
* 
Uitstekende presentatie- en facilitatievaardigheden en ervaring in het voorbereiden en faciliteren van leiderschaps- en teamontwikkeling workshops 
* 
Affiniteit met AI en de toepassing ervan binnen people‑processen. 
* 
Teamplayer met het vermogen om zich snel en effectief in nieuwe teams te integreren. 
* 
Ervaren in het beheren van stakeholders en klantrelaties in een dynamische en complexe omgeving. 
* 
In staat om veerkracht te tonen in stressvolle omstandigheden en goed te presteren onder druk. 
* 
Het vermogen om projecten te beheersen, problemen te analyseren en bij te dragen aan inzichtelijke, praktische en duurzame oplossingen voor onze klanten. 
* 
Heeft sterke analytische vaardigheden en is in staat gedrag, cultuur en leiderschap in een organisatiecontext te analyseren en duiden. 
* 
Past effectieve verandermanagementprincipes toe om gedrags-, cultuur- en organisatieveranderingen tijdens transformaties te ondersteunen. 
Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier 
* 
Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Bovenop je salaris ontvang je ook vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling). 
* 
Je krijgt een bepaald/onbepaald contract voor 40 uur. 
* 
Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding. 
* 
29 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken + de mogelijkheid om meer dagen te kopen. 
* 
Met het mobiliteitsbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een leaseauto, een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app. 
* 
Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt. 
* 
De mogelijkheid om 20 werkdagen per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken. 
* 
De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen. 
* 
Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen. 
* 
Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing. 
* 
Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk. 
En dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik hier 
Jouw toekomst samen met ons vormgeven? | Over je sollicitatieproces 
Voor deze vacature vragen we je om naast je cv ook een motivatiebrief te uploaden. Hiermee krijg je de kans om jouw drijfveren, motivatie en persoonlijkheid aan ons te laten zien. Bij EY staan wij achter het gebruik van AI-tools zoals ChatGPT, zolang jouw eigen toon en unieke persoonlijkheid zichtbaar blijven. 
Ons eerste contact: na jouw sollicitatie belt onze recruiter jou binnen 5 dagen voor een korte kennismaking. We verkennen alvast kort over en weer of de functie bij jou zou passen. 
Het eerste gesprek: we vragen je om van tevoren een online assessment te maken. Geen standaard vragenlijst, maar game-based waarin zowel naar jouw cognitieve vaardigheden als je gedragsvoorkeuren wordt gekeken. In het gesprek bespreken we de uitkomsten met elkaar en is er ook een collega van de betreffende afdeling aanwezig. Tijdens deze wederzijdse kennismaking leren we jou graag kennen en heb jij gelegenheid om ook jouw vragen te stellen. 
Het tweede gesprek: Als wij na het eerste gesprek een match zien en jij ook nog enthousiast bent, volgt er een tweede kennismaking. In dit gesprek gaan we dieper in op de functie en andere relevante thema’s en soms maakt ook een businesscase onderdeel uit van de procedure. Het kan zijn dat er nog een laatste gesprek plaatsvindt. 
We zijn een match. Je ontvangt van ons een aanbod en we doen een pre-employment screening. Daarna start jouw nieuwe uitdaging. Welkom bij EY! 
Uit onderzoek blijkt dat vrouwen minder snel solliciteren wanneer ze niet aan álle criteria voldoen. Solliciteer gerust, ook als je niet aan alles voldoet.

jd_text:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 
EY-Parthenon Quality Team
Assistant Manager 1 - Engagement Quality Review Testing
Function: EY-Parthenon Quality
Region Supported: Europe Central
About EY-Parthenon Quality Team
EY-Parthenon Quality supports the business in maintaining quality, consistency and accountability across engagements. The Engagement Quality Review Testing Process is designed to review completed engagements to identify compliance with internal policies and processes such as client engagement acceptance procedures, conflicts of interest, Independence, third-party risk management, reporting to name a few. The aim is to support consistent quality outcomes across all our engagements. Within Europe Central, the professional will help coordinate and execute engagement testing activities with a strong focus on engagement documentation, internal and external policies, direct interaction with Partners and their teams.
The opportunity
We are seeking an Assistant Manager 1 to join the EY-Parthenon Quality team supporting the Europe Central region. This role is ideal for a professional with strong risk management and policy interpretation skills, coupled with a practical understanding of EY-Parthenon service offerings such as Strategy, Due Diligence, Valuation, Business Modelling, Operational Turnaround, and Restructuring.
The successful candidate will support engagement quality reviews by evaluating compliance with firm policies and risk management requirements, assessing engagement evidence, identifying quality risks, and delivering clear, evidence-based findings that contribute to the continuous enhancement of the Quality Review Process (QRP).
Why this role matters
The Quality Review Process helps ensure engagements comply with firm policies, quality standards, and risk management requirements. By identifying potential risks and improvement opportunities, the role contributes to a culture of quality, strengthens compliance, and provides meaningful insights to Quality leadership.
Key responsibilities
* Support the end-to-end execution of Quality Reviews for EY-Parthenon engagements across Europe Central.
* Assess engagement documentation against QRP requirements, firm policies, and applicable risk management standards.
* Evaluate compliance with engagement acceptance, conflicts management, independence, contracting, approvals, and documentation requirements.
* Review Engagement Agreements (EAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and client deliverables to assess alignment with agreed scope and expected outcomes.
* Identify documentation gaps, quality concerns, risk indicators, and matters requiring escalation.
* Prepare clear, evidence-based findings, review summaries, and leadership updates.
* Engage with engagement teams, reviewers, and senior stakeholders to obtain clarifications and supporting evidence.
* Maintain complete audit trails, workpapers, and supporting documentation.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, including refinement of methodologies, templates, guidance, and review practices.
Skills and experience required
Skill area
What strong performance looks like
Risk Management & Policy Interpretation 
Strong understanding of quality, compliance, independence, conflicts management, AML requirements, and other risk management principles. Ability to apply professional skepticism and make sound, evidence-based judgments.
Business & Engagement Understanding
Ability to assess whether work performed and deliverables align with contractual scope, client requirements, and professional standards.
Analytical Thinking & Judgment
Capable of evaluating complex engagement scenarios, identifying key risks, distinguishing documentation deficiencies from substantive issues, and determining root causes.
Senior Stakeholder Management 
Confidence in engaging with Partners, Directors, and senior leaders, communicating observations effectively, and managing sensitive discussions professionally.
Documentation and review discipline 
Experience preparing structured workpapers, maintaining audit trails, and documenting findings and conclusions in a clear and defensible manner.
Candidate profile
* Postgraduate qualification or equivalent professional experience in risk management, quality, compliance, internal audit, controls, engagement management, or related areas.
* Experience in a Big 4 or similar professional services environment is preferred.
* Knowledge of engagement acceptance, contracting, independence, documentation controls, and quality review processes.
* Experience working with cross-border teams and senior stakeholders in a global environment.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise executive-ready reports.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel; familiarity with reporting and workflow management tools is advantageous.
Professional attributes
Quality mindset
High integrity, sound judgment, professional skepticism, accountability and commitment to consistent quality outcomes.
Analytical rigor
Attention to detail, clear logic, problem solving ability, comfort with complex fact patterns and confidence in evidence-based conclusions.
Collaboration style
Calm, constructive and responsive approach when working with engagement teams, Quality colleagues and senior leadership.
EY | Building a better working world 
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The opportunity
The Life Sciences Risk Consulting Services team focuses on biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device manufacturers, and the medical technology industry. You will be an integral part of this team helping clients identify, manage, and respond to risks while accelerating performance and maintaining growth. Our team advises clients on aligning risk and business objectives from strategy to execution, and improving coordination of risk activities across the organization for better outcomes. This involves working with life sciences clients to develop business processes, and design and implement systems to effectively manage these areas governed by the FDA and similar regulatory bodies globally:
* Quality Management Systems (including complaint management, CAPAs, deviations, change control, quality audit management, supplier quality management, etc.)

* Laboratory Information Management Systems
* Computer Systems Validation (following a GxP system development lifecycle)
In addition, our team also works on projects with clients to manage these Quality business processes for supply chain, manufacturing, commercial operations and R&D. * Design and execution of QMS and Regulatory processes.
* Performing computer systems validation activities as part of a service.

EY’s global Climate Change and Sustainability Services (CCaSS) teams understand the evolving pressures surrounding sustainability and climate-related issues. As a response, CCaSS helps companies navigate these challenges by understanding and evaluating broader impacts and outcomes, identifying opportunities, and supporting the reporting of non-financial performance risks to their stakeholders. Our professionals are highly qualified and trained, with deep industry knowledge and a global presence. 
Join EY Indonesia’s CCaSS to be a member of a multidisciplinary team working to empower clients in understanding and managing their environmental and social impacts, as well as the risks and opportunities arising from climate change and sustainability issues. With long-term experience in the Indonesian market as sustainability professionals, being a part of the team will enable you to experience continuous professional development through diverse experiences, world-class learning, and individually tailored coaching. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders to deliver on our promises to our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, our clients, and our communities.
About the opportunity
CCaSS is part of our Assurance group, which is one of the most trusted, respected, and influential organizations in the industry. As part of our team, you can take part in both advisory and assurance engagements, both enabling institutional progress in sustainability and ensuring the integrity of critical sustainability-related information. Our services span climate and decarbonization, sustainability, environment, health and safety (EHS), as well as sustainability reporting and assurance. 
Your key responsibilities
You’ll spend most of your time assisting clients to identify, measure, and manage impact, risks, and opportunities as they transition their organizations in alignment with global and national climate ambitions. As a sustainability practitioner, the development of your skills and capabilities are important to us amid rapidly expanding science and knowledge in sustainability. You will also actively contribute to the growth and development of the CCaSS practice by taking operational responsibility and accountability for engagement team support and delivery. 
Skills and attributes for success 
* Assisting, analyzing, and conducting customized research to support clients in sustainability/ESG transformation, decarbonization, climate change risks and opportunities, EHS, sustainability reporting and other related services.
* Supporting and conducting assurance engagements over non-financial information and sustainability disclosures, including reporting prepared in accordance with GRI Standards, IFRS S1 and S2, TCFD, SASB, and other relevant frameworks.
* Assisting clients in enhancing their sustainability reporting through materiality assessments, gap assessments against applicable reporting standards and frameworks, benchmarking analyses, and recommendations to strengthen reporting processes, governance, risk management, and internal controls.
* Maintaining strong working relationships with key business decision-makers, both internally and externally.
* Communicating EY’s scope of services and supporting the delivery of CCaSS projects, with an emphasis on complex and/or specialized issues within assurance and advisory capacities.
* Identifying and communicating trends, developments, and key performance drivers relevant to clients, while demonstrating a deep understanding of the industry and marketplace.
* Supporting client relationships, business development activities, and account management initiatives through the development of thought leadership, client and internal materials, as well as training.
To qualify for the role, you must have: 
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in environmental studies /engineering /sustainable development /management or business with a sustainability focus /accounting with exposure to sustainability subjects /other relevant disciplines (minimum GPA 3.20 out of 4.00). Additional training in sustainability/ESG-related topics would be an advantage.
* Internship or relevant experience in sustainability, energy, climate, environmental, or other related areas.
* Strong academic performance and a willingness to learn.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Indonesian and English.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and adaptability skills.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
* Openness to working on a variety of projects across different industries and sectors. 
* A self-motivated, pro-active, and committed mindset.
* Willingness and ability to travel, as necessary.
Ideally, you also have:
* Strong quantitative and data analysis capabilities, with intermediate to advanced Excel skills.
* Knowledge and interest in sustainability-related areas or topics, including sustainability reporting, climate change, decarbonization, ESG, or sustainable finance.
* Strong project management and personnel management skills.
