jd_text:
Our Strategy and Transactions (SaT) team works with clients to manage their capital agenda to drive competitive advantage and increased returns. As part of a global team of 10,000 professionals in 100 countries you will advise clients on preserving, optimising, raising or investing capital. Major groups (or, as we call them, sub-service lines and competencies) within SaT include Mergers and Acquisition Services, Valuation and Business Modelling, Project Finance, Restructuring Services, Operational Transaction Services, Transaction Support and Transaction Tax.
We are seeking to build on recent successes and continue to grow the origination and execution capacity of the team through the recruitment of a SaT professional at the Senior Associate level.
The opportunity
Leveraging an extensive global network, our SaT team provides sector-focused advice to navigate complexity by helping them to reimagine their eco-systems, reshape their portfolios and reinvent themselves for a better future. As part of this team you may also advise C-suite executives and boards on evaluating strategic alternatives in the context of transactions.
We work across all industries and operate in a broad range of disciplines including:
 * Merger and acquisition as well as transaction evaluation
 * Valuation, business modelling and economics
 * Transaction due diligence
 * Strategic planning and capital allocation
 * Budgeting, forecasting and planning
Your key responsibilities
As a Senior Associate within SaT team, you will:
 * Perform industry and company research utilising online tools and publicly available information 
 * Analyse the financial and operational results of companies targeted by reviewing accounting records and participating in interviews with management
 * Prepare analyses of historical and pro forma financial information to assess trends and fluctuations that may impact cash flow requirements and deal valuation
 * Deliver financial modeling engagements for strategic planning, capital allocation, transaction support, investment appraisal, financial planning and reporting purposes
 * Perform business valuation for transaction and financial reporting purposes
 * Work effectively as a team member by demonstrating your commitment to quality, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress. 
 * Assist in researching technical accounting issues to evaluate implications on transaction valuation and structuring 
 * Assist in preparing reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other parties
 * Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel 
Skills and attributes for success
 * Strong numerical, financial and modelling skills based on a well-developed understanding of financial statements
 * Advanced written and verbal communication skills
 * Strong Excel skills
 * Ability to conduct analysis, research and reporting to interpret, validate and reconcile complex data
 * Intellectual curiosity
 * Dedicated, innovative, resourceful, analytical and able to work under pressure
 * Foster an efficient, innovative and team-oriented work environment
To qualify for the role you must have
 * A bachelor’s degree preferably majoring in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or other financial related background
 * Minimum of 2 years of work experience in similar industry. Audit experience is an advantage.
 * Strong numerical, financial and modelling skills based on a well-developed understanding of financial statements
 * Sound commercial judgment and an ability to generate creative solutions to problems
 * A passion to provide high quality service to your clients
Ideally, you’ll also have
 * Professional qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, CFA.
What we look for
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities, and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.
What working at EY offers
EY offers a competitive remuneration package commensurate with your work experience, where you will be rewarded for your individual and team performance. We are committed to being an inclusive employer and are happy to consider flexible working arrangements (FWA), as needed, guided by our FWA Policy. Plus, we offer:
 * Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
 * Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
 * Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
 * Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

jd_text:
EY-Parthenon est un des leaders mondiaux du conseil de direction générale en matière de stratégie, de transformation et de transaction. Nous réunissons 25 000 consultants à travers le monde, intégrés à notre réseau de 400 000 professionnels EY dans 150 pays. De la conception à l’exécution de vos stratégies et de vos transactions, EY-Parthenon vous aide à redéfinir votre futur.
Nos équipes apportent un éclairage extérieur et des savoir-faire précis, combinant des expertises multisectorielles et multidisciplinaires approfondies, avec des capacités de pointe en matière d'analyse de données, d'IA et de technologie.
Nous accompagnons ainsi les directions générales et leur comité de direction, les conseils d'administration, les fonds d'investissement et les gouvernements à chaque étape de leurs réflexions et de leurs prises de décision, pour les aider à façonner leur avenir en toute confiance.
Vous cherchez de nouvelles opportunités professionnelles et êtes attirés par le conseil en transaction ? L’équipe TSE (Transaction, Strategy & Execution) d’EY-Parthenon recrute pour son bureau parisien. Nous accompagnons nos clients pour maximiser la valeur dans le cadre d’acquisitions, cessions ou de retournement.
L’opportunité :
Nous conseillons nos clients (Corporate, fonds d’investissement, institutionnels) sur des transactions de premier plan. Notre équipe de professionnels issus de divers secteurs dispose d'une forte expérience en M&A, nous permettant d'apporter à nos clients une expertise sectorielle et opérationnelle reconnue sur le marché
Notre offre de service est structurée de la façon suivante : 
• Buy & Integrate : nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs opérations d’acquisition en apportant une expertise approfondie sur les volets IT et technologiques, incluant le design de modèles opérationnels cibles, l’évaluation de la préparation au Day-1, l’identification et le chiffrage des synergies, ainsi que la définition et l’exécution de la stratégie d’intégration post-fusion (PMI). Nous réalisons également des due diligences IT à l’achat afin d’évaluer les performances passées et actuelles de la cible, d’identifier les risques IT, et d’estimer les opportunités de création de valeur.
• Sell & Separate : nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs opérations de cession en apportant une expertise IT et technologique, notamment à travers la définition du modèle opérationnel cible au Day-1, l’identification et l’évaluation des synergies, ainsi que la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de carve-out IT. Nous réalisons également des due diligences IT à la vente pour présenter les niveaux d’imbrication des systèmes, évaluer les performances IT passées et actuelles, identifier les risques, et valoriser les opportunités de création de valeur.
• Product & Technology Diligence : nous réalisons des missions de diligence produit et technologique pour des entreprises à forte composante logicielle. Cela inclut l’évaluation des capacités produit, des roadmaps, de l’architecture logicielle, de la dette technique, ainsi que de l’organisation et des processus associés aux équipes de développement logiciel.
Notre équipe à Paris - actuellement en phase de forte croissance - recrute des consultants seniors H/F pour continuer à servir au mieux nos clients et soutenir notre ambition actuelle. 
Vos missions :
En tant que membre clé de l’équipe, vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble de nos missions. Vos responsabilités incluront notamment :
• Analyser la documentation transactionnelle et conduire des entretiens afin d’identifier les enjeux et risques critiques liés à l’IT, à la technologie et au business dans le cadre d’une opération envisagée.
• Réaliser des analyses techniques et traduire les résultats en impacts IT et financiers, tout en étant capable de les présenter à un public non technique.
• Contribuer aux projets d’intégration post-fusion (PMI), de carve-out IT, ainsi qu’au design et à la mise en œuvre de modèles opérationnels cibles (Target Operating Models - TOM).
• Encadrer et accompagner les membres Juniors de l’équipe.
Profil recherché :
• Diplômé d’une grande école de commerce ou d’ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en IT, technologies ou management de l’innovation appréciée.
• Minimum de 2 ans d’expérience professionnelle.
• Solides capacités d’analyse et de synthèse.
• Bonne compréhension des concepts IT et intérêt marqué pour les nouvelles technologies.
• Une expérience en transaction, en stratégie IT ou en projets de transformation IT est un plus.
• Capacité d’adaptation aux nouveaux challenges/concepts.
• Capacité et volonté de voyager dans le cadre des missions.
• Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais. 
L’offre EY-Parthenon :
Vous bénéficierez d’un régime de rémunération et de bonus compétitif, établi sur la base de votre performance et de votre contribution à nos activités. Par ailleurs, EY-Parthenon vous permettra de : 
• Développer de nouvelles compétences et accélérer votre carrière chez un des leaders du conseil en transaction et transformation
• Travailler dans un environnement international, avec de fortes opportunités de mobilité en interne
• Bénéficier de l’accompagnement et du coaching d’une équipe d’experts reconnus sur le marché
Vivez l’expérience EY, Rejoignez-nous !
Dans le cadre de sa politique Diversité, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help build a better working world.

You will combine strong technical skills with practical commercial, legislative, and industry knowledge to lead a team in providing tax services. Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

We invite highly motivated and dynamic professionals with relevant experience to join our Infrastructure Advisory, Energy & Utilities practice.

jd_text:
Job Description
KPMG's People & Organisation practice helps organisations transform their workforce, leadership, culture, and HR function to achieve sustainable business outcomes. In an increasingly dynamic business environment shaped by technological disruption, evolving workforce expectations, and changing market demands, organisations must continuously adapt to remain competitive.
We partner with clients to design and implement people-centric transformation programmes that align workforce strategy with business priorities, enabling organisational agility, workforce effectiveness, and long-term growth.
We are looking for experienced professionals who are passionate about people, workforce, and organisational transformation to join us as Senior Associates / Assistant Managers. You will play a key role in supporting project delivery, managing workstreams, engaging client stakeholders, and contributing to business development initiatives across a broad range of transformation programmes.
What You Will Do
Support and manage client engagements and business development activities across areas such as:
* Organisation & Workforce Transformation
* HR Transformation
* Culture & Change Transformation
* Leadership Transformation
* Talent Transformation
* Learning & Development
* Post-Deal People Services
Your responsibilities may include:
* Managing project workstreams and supporting end-to-end delivery of transformation programmes
* Conducting analyses and developing recommendations related to workforce, organisation, talent, leadership, culture, and HR transformation
* Preparing and reviewing presentations, reports, and client-ready deliverables
* Facilitating workshops, stakeholder engagement sessions, and change management activities
* Supporting the design and implementation of transformation strategies and solutions
* Managing day-to-day client interactions and coordinating project activities across teams
* Contributing to proposal development, solution design, thought leadership, and business development activities
* Coaching and providing guidance to junior team members
⠀
The Ideal Candidate Should Possess the Following
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Sociology, Communications, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, Social Sciences, or a related discipline
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in management consulting, people consulting, organisational transformation, change management, HR transformation, talent management, workforce strategy, learning and development, or related fields
* Experience supporting and managing workstreams within transformation, HR, workforce, or organisational change projects
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking capabilities
* Ability to translate data and insights into practical and actionable recommendations
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presentation and stakeholder engagement capabilities
* Experience developing client deliverables and executive-level presentations
* Self-motivated, responsive, responsible, and results-oriented
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across clients, teams, and disciplines
* Resourceful, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word
Preferred Attributes
* Experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Organisation Design
* Workforce Transformation
* HR Transformation
* Change Management
* Talent Management
* Leadership Development
* Learning & Development
* Post-Merger Integration or Workforce Due Diligence
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional services, or transformation environment
* Experience facilitating workshops and engaging senior stakeholders
* Interest in emerging trends such as people analytics, HR technology, AI, skills-based organisations, and the future of work
* Demonstrated ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to team development
